title: Zambian president Hichilema votes as he seeks second term
english: Zambian President Hakainde Hichilema has officially cast his ballot in Lusaka as he runs for re-election. This vote is considered a critical test for his administration, which is facing public scrutiny over inflation and the high cost of living. Voters will determine if the economic reforms implemented during his first term are sufficient to secure his political future.
amharic: የዛምቢያው ፕሬዝዳንት ሃካይንዴ ሂቺሌማ ለሁለተኛ የስልጣን ዘመን በሉሳካ ድምፃቸውን ሰጥተዋል። ይህ ምርጫ መንግስታቸው ባከናወናቸው የኢኮኖሚ ማሻሻያዎች እና እየጨመረ በመጣው የኑሮ ውድነት ዙሪያ የህዝብን አቋም የሚለካበት ነው። መራጮች የፕሬዝዳንቱ የኢኮኖሚ ለውጥ ጥረቶች በቂ ናቸው ወይስ አይደሉም የሚለውን በድምፃቸው ይወስናሉ።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Zaambiyaa Hakaayindee Hiichiileemaa irra deebi'anii filamuuf magaalaa Luusaakaatti sagalee isaanii kennaniiru. Filannoon kun mootummaan isaanii jijjiirama dinagdee fiduuf tattaaffii godhe fi gatiin jireenyaa dabaluun isaa biyyattiirratti dhiibbaa uumuu isaa kan mirkaneessu dha. Lammiileen Zaambiyaa hojiin pirezidaantichaa waggoota darban keessa hojjetan itti fufiinsa isaanii kan murteessu ta'a.

title: Person fined after using foghorn to wake sleeping polar bear
english: An individual in Norway's Svalbard archipelago was ordered to pay a 50,000 kroner fine for intentionally startling a resting polar bear. The person blew a ship's foghorn while passing the animal, which is a violation of local laws meant to protect wildlife from unnecessary human interference. The offender has accepted the penalty, which serves as a reminder that disturbing protected species in the region is strictly prohibited.
amharic: በኖርዌይ የስቫልባርድ ደሴቶች አንድ ግለሰብ የተኛን የዋልታ ድብ በጭጋግ ማስጠንቀቂያ ድምፅ (foghorn) በመረበሹ የ50,000 ክሮነር ቅጣት ተጥሎበታል። ድርጊቱ የተፈፀመው በጀልባ ሲጓዙ የነበሩ ሰዎች ድቡን ሲያዩ ድምፅ በማሰማት ድቡ እንዲነቃና ቦታውን እንዲለቅ በማድረጋቸው ነው። አካባቢውን የሚገዛው ህግ ማንኛውንም የዱር እንስሳ ያለአግባብ መረበሽ ስለሚከለክል፣ ግለሰቡ ቅጣቱን ለመክፈል ተስማምቷል።
oromo: Naannoo Svalbard kan biyya Noorweeyitti nama tokko orma hirriibaa keessa jiru sagalee guddiftuu bidiruu (foghorn) fayyadamuun waan dammeesseef qarshii 50,000 kaffaluuf dirqameera. Namichi kun kan gocha kana raawwate bineensicha lafa boqotutti jiru sagaleen wal-dhibdee uumee akka innis iddoo sana gadhiisee deemutti waan ta'eef, kunis seera eegumsa bineensotaa diigudha. Namichi kun adabbicha fudhateera, kunis naannicha keessatti bineensota eegumsa addaa qaban dammeessuun dhoorkaa ta'uu kan yaadachiisuudha.

title: Will all-out war in Yemen reignite as the Houthis escalate attacks?
english: Concerns are rising that Yemen could return to full-scale war following a recent surge in deadly Houthi attacks against government sites, civilian areas, and commercial shipping. These escalations have shattered the relative calm established by the 2022 truce, prompting government leaders to vow a firm response. While the government remains open to a political resolution, the intensifying violence threatens to destabilize the region further.
amharic: በየመን የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በቅርቡ በወሰዷቸው አደገኛ ጥቃቶች ምክንያት ሀገሪቱ ወደ ሙሉ ጦርነት ልትመለስ ትችላለች የሚል ስጋት ተፈጥሯል። እነዚህ ጥቃቶች ከ2022 ጀምሮ የቆየውን አንጻራዊ ሰላም በመጣስ በመንግስት ተቋማት፣ በሲቪል አካባቢዎች እና በንግድ መርከቦች ላይ ጉዳት አድርሰዋል። የየመን መንግስት ለጥቃቶቹ ጠንካራ ምላሽ እንደሚሰጥ ቢገልጽም፣ በሰላማዊ መንገድ ለመፍታት የሚያስችሉ አማራጮችን አሁንም እንደሚፈልግ አስታውቋል።
oromo: Houthiin weerara isaa guddifachuu isaan, Yemen gara waraana guutuu ta'eetti deebi'uu dandeessi soda jedhu uumameera. Weerara kana kanaan dura bara 2022 nagaa bu'ee ture kan diige yoo ta'u, bakkeewwan mootummaa, iddoowwan nagaa fi dooniiwwan daldalaa irratti miidhaa guddaa geessiseera. Mootummaan Yemen tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachuuf qophii ta'us, karaa nagaatiin furmaata argachuuf fedhii akka qabu ibseera.

title: Turkiye’s AK Party turns 25: A journey of change and renewal
english: Turkiye’s Justice and Development (AK) Party is celebrating its 25th anniversary, marking a quarter-century of political leadership under President Recep Tayyip Erdogan. The party attributes its long-term success and stability to its deep historical roots and its ability to effectively address the evolving needs of the public. By transforming societal expectations into concrete government policies, the movement has maintained widespread support while navigating various national and global challenges.
amharic: የቱርክ የፍትህ እና ልማት ፓርቲ (AK) የተመሰረተበትን 25ኛ ዓመት የምስረታ በዓል እያከበረ ነው። ፓርቲው በፕሬዝዳንት ረሲፕ ታይፕ ኤርዶغان አመራር ስር ላለፉት ሃያ አምስት ዓመታት የቆየ ሲሆን፣ ይህን ያህል ጊዜ በስልጣን ለመቆየት የቻለው ከህዝብ ጥያቄዎች ጋር በመጣጣም እና ተጨባጭ የፖሊሲ ለውጦችን በማምጣት ነው። ፓርቲው ስኬቱን የጠበቀው የህዝብን ፍላጎት ወደ ተግባራዊ መርሃ ግብሮች በመቀየር እና በሀገር አቀፍ እንዲሁም በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ የተከሰቱ ችግሮችን በብቃት በመወጣት ነው።
oromo: Paartiin AK kan Turkii waggaa 25ffaa hundeeffama isaa kabajachaa jiru yoo ta'u, kunis waggaa 25ffaa hoogganummaa Pirezidaant Rajab Xayyib Erdogaan mul'isa. Paartichi milkaa'ina isaa fi tasgabbii inni waggoota dheeraaf qabate, hidda seenaa isaa fi fedhii hawaasaa irratti hundaa'ee hojjechuu isaan akka ibse himameera. Paartichi gaaffilee hawaasaa gara karooraa fi imaammataatti jijjiiruudhaan, rakkoolee biyya keessaa fi idil-addunyaa injifachaa deggarsa bal'aa argachuu danda'eera.

title: Iran says Strait of Hormuz under its control, rejects Trump claims
english: Iranian military officials have asserted that the Strait of Hormuz is entirely under their control and management, directly contradicting recent claims of U.S. dominance made by President Donald Trump. Tehran insists that no ships can pass through this vital waterway without its permission and has tied the future reopening of the strait to U.S. compliance with existing peace deal obligations. This development highlights the ongoing tensions as Iran continues to restrict maritime traffic amid its broader conflict with the United States.
amharic: የኢራን ወታደራዊ ባለስልጣናት የሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤ ሙሉ በሙሉ በእነሱ ቁጥጥር ስር እንደሚገኝ በመግለጽ፣ የዩናይትድ ስቴትሱ ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ቀደም ብለው የሰጡትን መግለጫ ውድቅ አድርገዋል። ቴህራን ያለምንም ፈቃዳቸው ማንም መርከብ በዚህ ወሳኝ የውሃ መስመር ማለፍ እንደማይችል በመግለጽ፣ የባህረ ሰላጤው መከፈት በአሜሪካ የሰላም ስምምነት ግዴታዎች ላይ የተመሰረተ መሆኑን አስታውቃለች። ይህ ክስተት በኢራን እና በአሜሪካ መካከል ያለውን የባህር ላይ ውጥረት አባብሶ ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni waraana Iraan akka jedhanitti, daandiin galaana Hormuz guutummaatti to'annoo isaanii jala akka jiru ibsaniiru; kunis ibsa kanaan dura pirezidaant Doonald Tiraamp daandicharratti to'annoo guutuu qabna jechuun kennan kan mormudha. Teheran akka himtetti, hayyama isii malee markaan tokkollee daandii kana keessa darbuu akka hin dandeenyeefi, daandichii akka banamuuf immoo Ameerikaan dirqama walii galtee nagaa kabajuu akka qabdu ibsiteetti. Haalli kun walitti bu'iinsa Ameerikaafi Iraan gidduutti daandii galaanicharratti jiru kan dabaludha.

title: Pro-Palestine football fans lament West Ham for signing Manor Solomon
english: West Ham United has faced significant backlash from fans after signing Israeli winger Manor Solomon from Tottenham Hotspur. Supporters are protesting the move due to the player's vocal public support for Israel's military actions and policies throughout the ongoing conflict in Gaza. While the club views the signing as a strategic move to help secure promotion, the decision has triggered online criticism and calls for boycotts similar to those experienced at his previous clubs.
amharic: ዌስት هام ዩናይትድ የእስራኤላዊውን የክንፍ ተጫዋች ማኖር ሶሎሞንን ከቶተንሃም ሆትስፐር መቅጠሩ በደጋፊዎች ዘንድ ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ አስነስቷል። ተጫዋቹ በጋዛ እየተካሄደ ባለው ጦርነት የእስራኤልን ወታደራዊ እርምጃዎች በይፋ በመደገፉ ምክንያት ደጋፊዎቹ ውሳኔውን በመቃወም ላይ ናቸው። ክለቡ ተጫዋቹን የፈረመው ወደ ፕሪሚየር ሊግ ለመመለስ ቢሆንም፣ ውሳኔው ቀደም ሲል በሌሎች ክለቦች እንደታየው ሁሉ አሁንም በኢንተርኔት ላይ ትችት እና የቦይኮት ጥሪዎችን እየሳበ ይገኛል።
oromo: West Ham United taphataa garra galii Israa'el Manor Solomon gatuu isaa hordofee, mormiin cimaan garee deggartoota biraa irraa itti dhufeera. Deggartoonni kunneen, taphatichi waraana Gaaza keessatti adeemsifamu ilaalchisee Israa'eliif deggarsa ifa ta'e waan kenneef murtee kana mormuudha. Gareen kun taphaticha kan qaxarate gara Liigii Priimiyeritti deebi'uuf akka isa gargaaruuf ta'us, murteen kun akkuma klaboota kanaan duraa, miidiyaalee hawaasaa irratti qeeqa fi yaada boycotii walitti fufaa jira.

title: Oman says massive oil spill reaches coastline: What damage could it do?
english: A significant oil spill from the tanker Caroline Bezengi has reached the coastline of Oman after leaking for several weeks. The spill, originating from a vessel that ran aground following an explosion, now covers over 2,000 square kilometers and threatens sensitive marine ecosystems near Ras Madraka and Masirah Island. Omani authorities are currently working to manage the environmental damage caused by the thousands of barrels of oil now impacting these coastal regions.
amharic: ካሮላይን ቤዘንጊ የተባለ የነዳጅ መርከብ በኦማን የባህር ጠረፍ ላይ በመጋጨቱ ሳቢያ ለበርካታ ሳምንታት የፈሰሰው ከፍተኛ መጠን ያለው ነዳጅ ወደ ኦማን የባህር ዳርቻ ደርሷል። ፍንዳታ ደርሶበት ከተጋጨ በኋላ መፍሰስ የጀመረው ይህ ነዳጅ አሁን ከ2,000 ካሬ ኪሎ ሜትር በላይ ቦታን የተቆጣጠረ ሲሆን፣ በራስ ማድራካ እና በማሲራህ ደሴት አቅራቢያ የሚገኙ ስሱ የባህር አካባቢዎችን ስጋት ላይ ጥሏል። የኦማን ባለስልጣናት በባህር ዳርቻው ላይ እየደረሰ ያለውን ከፍተኛ የአካባቢ ብክለት ለመቆጣጠር ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Markabii boba'aa 'Caroline Bezengi' jedhamu kan gubbaatti dhohee caccabe irraa kan buruqu jiru boba'aan hedduun, torbanoota hedduu booda qarqara galaana Omaan ga'eera. Boba'aan kun lafa iskuweer kiilomeetira 2,000 ol ta'u kan haguuge yoo ta'u, naannoo Ras Madraka fi Masirah Islanditti lubbu qabeeyyii galaanaatti miidhaa guddaa geessisuu danda'a. Abbootiin taayitaa Omaan miidhaa naannoo qarqara galaanaatti gahaa jiru kana hir'isuuf hojjechaa jiru.

title: Ukraine attacks key Russian grain terminal on Black Sea port
english: Ukraine recently launched a strike against a major Russian grain terminal located at the port of Novorossiysk. In response, Russia carried out retaliatory attacks on grain facilities within Ukraine’s Odesa region. These reciprocal strikes on vital food export infrastructure raise serious concerns regarding global food security for vulnerable nations.
amharic: ዩክሬን በኖቮሮሲይስክ ወደብ በሚገኘው የሩሲያ ዋና የእህል መጋዘን ላይ ጥቃት ሰንዝራለች። በምላሹም ሩሲያ በዩክሬን ኦዴሳ ክልል በሚገኙ የእህል መሠረተ ልማቶች ላይ ጥቃት ፈጽማለች። ሁለቱ አገራት እርስ በርስ በሚያደርጉት በዚህ የጥቃት ልውውጥ ሳቢያ በምግብ እጥረት ለተጎዱ አገራት ዓለም አቀፍ የምግብ ዋስትና ስጋት ላይ ወድቋል።
oromo: Yukireen buufata doonii Novorossiysk kan Raashiyaa keessatti argamu irratti haleellaa raawwatteerti. Kana boodas Raashiyaan bakka qubannaa midhaan sanyii kan naannoo Odesaa Yukireen keessatti haleelteerti. Wal-jijjiirraa haleellaa kana lamaan gidduutti godhamaa jiru kun biyyoota midhaan alaa galchaniif rakkoo nageenya nyaataa guddaa uumee jira.

title: Ebola outbreak caused by new ‘animal transmission’: What that means
english: A recent study reveals that the current deadly Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo originated from a fresh animal-to-human transmission rather than previous virus strains. This specific Bundibugyo variant is spreading at an alarming rate, with over 2,000 fatalities recorded so far. Experts clarify that while the spillover is new, it does not represent a mutation or a change in how animals transmit the disease.
amharic: አዲስ ጥናት እንደሚያሳየው በኮንጎ ዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ እየተስፋፋ ያለው ገዳይ የኢቦላ ወረርሽኝ የቀድሞዎቹን የቫይረስ ዝርያዎች ሳይሆን ከአንስሳት ወደ ሰው በመተላለፉ የተከሰተ ነው። ቡንዲቡጊዮ የተሰኘው ይህ የቫይረስ ዝርያ በፍጥነት በመዛመት ከ2,000 በላይ ሰዎችን ለህልፈት ዳርጓል። ባለሙያዎች እንደሚያብራሩት ይህ ክስተት አዲስ ቢሆንም ቫይረሱ አልተቀየረም እንዲሁም እንስሳት ቫይረሱን የሚያስተላልፉበት መንገድ አልተለወጠም።
oromo: qorannoon haaraan akka agarsiisutti, dhibeen Ebolaa biyya Koongoo keessatti babal'achaa jiru kun dhukkuba kanaan dura ture osoo hin taane, bineensa irraa gara namaatti darbuun kan jalqabe dha. Vaayrasii 'Bundibugyo' jedhamu kanaan namoonni 2,000 ol du'aniiru. Ogeeyyoonni akka ibsanitti, vaayrasichi jijjiiramni irra hin geenye akkasumas bineensi dhukkubicha kan ittiin dabarsu dandeettii isaa keessatti jijjiiramni hin jiru.

title: Report from scene of Palestinian homes besieged by settlers
english: Israeli settlers have surrounded Palestinian homes in the West Bank village of Qusra, trapping families inside. During the siege, the residents have been deprived of essential utilities, including water and electricity. This incident highlights the ongoing danger and severe restrictions faced by Palestinians living in the occupied territory.
amharic: የእስራኤል ሰፈራ ሰሪዎች በምዕራብ ባንክ በምትገኘው ኩስራ መንደር የሚገኙ የፍልስጤም ቤተሰቦችን ከበው ይገኛሉ። በአካባቢው በሚኖሩ ነዋሪዎች ላይ በተደረገው ይህ ከበባ፣ ቤተሰቦቹ የውሃ እና የኤሌክትሪክ አገልግሎት እንዳያገኙ ተደርጓል። ይህ ድርጊት በተያዘው የፍልስጤም ግዛት ውስጥ ነዋሪዎች የሚገጥሟቸውን ከባድ ችግሮች እና ስጋቶች ያሳያል።
oromo: Buqqaattoonni Israa'el qe'ee fi manaa jiraattoota Falasxiin kan Qusra, naannoo Baanki Dhihaa keessa jiran marsanii jiru. Miidhaa kana keessatti maatiin kunneen bishaan fi ibsaan akka itti hin geenye godhamanii jiru. Gochi kun rakkoo fi dhiibbaa cimaa jiraattoonni Falasxiin naannoo sanatti qabsoo irratti argaman agarsiisa.

title: Lebanese Americans sue US over Israel’s rights abuses in Lebanon war
english: A group of Lebanese Americans has filed a lawsuit against the US government and several major defense contractors for allegedly violating the Leahy Law. The plaintiffs, who include individuals with damaged property in Lebanon, argue that US military aid and weapon sales to Israel facilitate human rights abuses in the ongoing conflict. They are seeking legal action to hold these entities accountable, claiming that American laws restricting support to countries involved in rights violations are being ignored regarding Israel.
amharic: የሊባኖስ አሜሪካውያን ቡድን በአሜሪካ መንግስት እና በበርካታ የጦር መሳሪያ አምራች ኩባንያዎች ላይ ክስ መስርተዋል። ተከሳሾቹ እስራኤል በሊባኖስ እያደረሰች ባለው ጥቃት የአሜሪካን ህግ በመጣስ ወታደራዊ እርዳታ እና መሳሪያ በማቅረብ የሰብአዊ መብት ጥሰት እንዲባባስ አድርገዋል ሲሉ ከሳሾቹ ይከራከራሉ። በሊባኖስ ንብረት የሆኑባቸው አሜሪካውያን፣ የአሜሪካ መንግስት በሰብአዊ መብት ጥሰት ለሚሳተፉ ሀገራት ድጋፍ እንዳያደርግ የሚከለክለውን ህግ እያስከበረ አይደለም በማለት ለፍርድ ቤት አቤቱታ አቅርበዋል።
oromo: Humni lammiilee Ameerikaa kanneen sabboonummaa Liibanoota qaban tokko, mootummaa Ameerikaa fi dhaabbilee meeshaa waraanaa gurguran irratti himata bananiiru. Himataan kunneen, Ameerikaan gargaarsa waraanaa fi meeshaa waraanaa gara Israa'elitti erguun seera biyyattii kan 'Leahy Law' jedhamu kan cabsitee fi mirga namoomaa darbuu ishee akka gargaarte dubbatu. Namoonni qabeenyi isaanii Liibaanoos keessatti miidhame, Ameerikaan Israa'eliin gargaaruu ishee akka dhaabduu fi seera darbaa jirtuuf gaafatamummaa akka fudhatu gaafachaa jiru.

title: Spanish Super Cup will be held in Turkiye in 2027
english: The 2027 Spanish Super Cup is scheduled to take place at the Ataturk Olympic Stadium in Istanbul, Turkey. The tournament will run from February 2 to 7 and include top clubs Barcelona, Real Madrid, Atletico Madrid, and Real Sociedad. This move comes as a temporary change because the Asian Cup schedule conflicts with hosting the event in Saudi Arabia, which is expected to host the tournament again in 2028.
amharic: የ2027 የስፔን ሱፐር ካፕ ውድድር በቱርክ፣ ኢስታንቡል በሚገኘው አታቱርክ ኦሊምፒክ ስታዲየም እንደሚካሄድ ተገልጿል። ውድድሩ ከየካቲት 2 እስከ 7 የሚቆይ ሲሆን ባርሴሎና፣ ሪያል ማድሪድ፣ አትሌቲኮ ማድሪድ እና ሪያል ሶሴዳድ ይሳተፉበታል። ይህ ለውጥ የተደረገው በሳውዲ አረቢያ ሊካሄድ የነበረው ውድድር ከእስያ ዋንጫ ጋር በመደራረቡ ምክንያት ሲሆን፣ ውድድሩ በ2028 ወደ ሳውዲ አረቢያ እንደሚመለስ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Qophiin 'Spanish Super Cup' bara 2027 magaalaa Istanbul, Turkey kan argamu 'Ataturk Olympic Stadium' irratti akka gaggeeffamu ibsameera. Taphoonni kunneen guraandhala 2 hanga 7 kan turan yoo ta'u, kilaboota gurguddoo kanneen akka Barcelona, Real Madrid, Atletico Madrid fi Real Sociedad kan hirmaachisan ta'a. Jijjiiramni kun kan mudate qophiin kun Saudii Arabiyaatti akka hin gaggeeffamneef walitti bu'iinsa 'Asian Cup' waliin walqabatee yoo ta'u, bara 2028 irra deebi'ee Saudii Arabiyaatti akka deebi'u eegama.

title: Turkiye lays out ‘mechanisms’ of defence pact with Pakistan, Saudi Arabia
english: Turkiye, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan have established a new military alliance that treats an attack on one member as an assault on all three. This pact focuses on institutionalizing cooperation between their top defense and foreign officials through regular high-level meetings. The partnership also aims to advance military capabilities by conducting joint exercises and collaborating on the development of new technologies like drones and artificial intelligence.
amharic: ቱርክ፣ ሳዑዲ ዓረቢያ እና ፓኪስታን በአንዱ ላይ የሚሰነዘር ጥቃት በሦስቱም ላይ እንደተሰነዘረ የሚቆጠርበት አዲስ የጋራ ወታደራዊ ስምምነት ተፈራርመዋል። ይህ ስምምነት የሦስቱን አገራት ከፍተኛ የመከላከያ እና የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትሮች በማቀናጀት የጋራ ግንኙነታቸውን በተቋማዊ መንገድ ለማጠናከር ያለመ ነው። በተጨማሪም አገራቱ በጋራ ወታደራዊ ልምምዶች፣ በቴክኖሎጂ ልማት እና በድሮን እንዲሁም በአርቴፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ ዘርፎች በጋራ ለመስራት ተስማምተዋል።
oromo: Turkiin, Sa’udii Arabiyaafi Paakistaan walii-galtee waadaa waraanaa haaraa kanneen keessaa tokko irratti haleellaan raawwatame sadanuu irratti akka raawwatameetti fudhatamu mallatteessaniiru. Walii-galteen kun jiddu-galeessa ministiroota ittisaa fi dhimmi alaa biyyoota sadanii walitti fiduun hariiroo isaanii caalaatti cimsuuf kan karoorfatedha. Dabalataanis, biyyoonni kunneen leenjii waraanaa waloo gaggeessuu, akkasumas teeknoolojii haaraa fi meeshaalee waraanaa ammayyaa kanneen akka xiyyaara nama hin feene (drones) fi 'artificial intelligence' waliin misoomsuuf waliigalaaniiru.

title: Falling Danube flow forces shutdown of Romania’s sole nuclear plant
english: Romania has suspended operations at its only nuclear power plant because record-low water levels in the Danube River are insufficient to cool the facility's reactors. This plant typically provides one-fifth of the nation's electricity, forcing the government to rely on alternative energy sources and request public conservation. The shutdown is part of a broader crisis affecting the Danube as severe drought conditions continue to impact both energy production and river transport across Europe.
amharic: በሮማኒያ የሚገኘው ብቸኛው የኒውክሌር ኃይል ማመንጫ ጣቢያ በዳኑብ ወንዝ ላይ የተከሰተው ከፍተኛ የውሃ መጠን መቀነስ ምክንያት ስራውን አቁሟል። የኃይል ማመንጫው ለሀገሪቱ የኤሌክትሪክ ፍላጎት 20 በመቶውን ድርሻ የያዘ በመሆኑ፣ መንግስት የኃይል እጥረት እንዳይፈጠር አማራጭ የኃይል ምንጮችን በመጠቀም ለህዝቡ የኃይል ቁጠባ እንዲያደርግ አሳስቧል። በአውሮፓ የገጠመው የድርቅ አደጋ የወንዙን የውሃ መጠን ወደ ታሪካዊ ዝቅተኛ ደረጃ በማውረዱ የኤሌክትሪክ ምርትንም ሆነ የወንዝ ትራንስፖርትን በእጅጉ ጎድቷል።
oromo: Roomaaniyaa keessatti buufanni anniisaa niwuukileraa tokkichi biyyattii laga Daayinuubii keessatti sadarkaa bishaan hir'achuu isaatiin wal-qabatee hojii dhaabeera. Buufanni kun anniisaa elektirikaa biyyattii keessaa harka shan keessaa tokko kan maddisiisu waan ta'eef, mootummaan maddawwan anniisaa biroo fayyadamuuf fi hawaasni qusannoo akka godhu gaafateera. Hanqinni bishaan laga kanaa sababa gogiinsa cimaa Awurooppaa keessatti muudateen kan dhufe yoo ta'u, kunis oomisha anniisaa fi geejjiba lagichaa irratti dhiibbaa hamaa geessiseera.

title: Infantino’s FIFA fate must go to an election, says Africa football chief
english: The head of African football, Patrice Motsepe, is insisting that FIFA President Gianni Infantino remain in his role until the scheduled elections next March. While major global football organizations are calling for Infantino to resign following controversies over his proposals to sell World Cup stakes, Motsepe maintains that the democratic voting process is the only appropriate way to determine his future. He argues that the 211 member nations should decide whether they still have confidence in Infantino’s leadership through a formal ballot.
amharic: የአፍሪካ እግር ኳስ ኮንፌዴሬሽን ፕሬዝዳንት ፓትሪስ ሞትሴፔ፣ የፊፋው ፕሬዝዳንት ጃኒ ኢንፋንቲኖ እስከ መጪው መጋቢት ወር ድረስ በስልጣን ላይ እንዲቆዩ እና ውሳኔውም በምርጫ እንዲወሰን ጠይቀዋል። በርካታ ዓለም አቀፍ የእግር ኳስ ማህበራት ኢንፋንቲኖ የዓለም ዋንጫን ድርሻ ለመሸጥ ባቀረቡት አወዛጋቢ እቅድ ምክንያት ከስልጣናቸው እንዲለቁ ግፊት እያደረጉ ቢሆንም፣ ሞትሴፔ ግን ህጋዊው የፊፋ የምርጫ ሂደት ብቻ መከተል እንዳለበት ያምናሉ። የፊፋ 211 አባል ሀገራት በድምጽ ብልጫ መሪውን መደገፍ ወይም መቃወም እንዳለባቸውም አስረድተዋል።
oromo: Pirezedantiin kubbaa miillaa Afrikaa Paatriis Mootseepee, pirezedantiin FIFA Jaannii Infaantiinoo hanga filannoo ji'a Bitootessaa dhufuutti bakka isaanii akka turanii fi garaagarummaan jiru karaa sanduuqa filannootiin akka hiikamu gaafataniiru. Jaarmoolen kubbaa miillaa gurguddoon addunyaa, Infaantiinoo karoora isaan qabeenya waancaa addunyaa gurguruuf qaban kana irratti mormuun akka gadi lakkisan gaafachaa jiru. Haa ta'u malee, Mootseepee murteen waa'ee isaanii karaa dimokiraatawaa ta'een miseensota 211 tiin akka murtaa'uufi, isaanis filannoo irratti amanannaa akka qaban ykn hin qabne akka ibsan dubbataniiru.

title: Video: How settler attacks and water diversion erased a Palestinian community
english: A Palestinian Bedouin community near Jericho has been forced to abandon their homes due to persistent settler violence and the loss of essential water resources. Once a thriving oasis, the Ein al-Auja spring has been reduced to a trickle after its water was diverted, leaving the land dry. More than 100 families have been displaced as living conditions became impossible, forcing them to relocate to distant areas.
amharic: በኢያሪኮ አቅራቢያ የሚኖሩ ፍልስጤማውያን ቤተሰቦች በተደጋጋሚ በሚፈጸምባቸው የሰፋሪዎች ጥቃት እና የውኃ አቅርቦት መዛባት ምክንያት ቀያቸውን ለቀው ለመውጣት ተገደዋል። በአንድ ወቅት በውኃ ምንጮች ትታወቅ የነበረችው የአይን አል-አውጃ አካባቢ ውኃ በመዛበቷ ለኑሮ አስቸጋሪ ሆናለች። ከ100 በላይ የሚሆኑ ቤተሰቦች የመኖሪያ ቦታቸውን ጥለው ወደ ተለያዩ አካባቢዎች ለመሰደድ ተገደዋል።
oromo: Maatiin biyya Palestina kan Yerikoo bira jiraatan, haleellaa qaqqabuufi dhabamuun bishaan irraa kan ka'e qe'ee isaanii gadi lakkisuuf dirqamaniiru. Bakki Ein al-Auja jedhamu kun yeroo darbe bishaan baay'ee qabaatee kan beekamu ture, garuu ammaan tana bishaanichi garabiraa waan deebifameef lafti sun goginaaf saaxilameera. Maatii 100 ol ta'an haalli jireenyaa waan itti ulfaateef qe'ee isaanii irraa buqqa'anii gara bakka biraatti godaananiiru.

title: Iranian press review: Tehran says it will no longer wait to be attacked
english: Iran has announced a significant shift in its military policy, moving away from a defensive stance to a more aggressive approach against U.S. forces in the region. This change follows the appointment of new military commanders by Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei to replace those lost in recent conflicts. Officials have confirmed this strategy, citing recent operations against regional opposition groups as evidence of their new, proactive stance.
amharic: ኢራን በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ለሚገኙ የአሜሪካ ኃይሎች ያላትን አቋም ከመከላከል ወደ ጥቃት መሸጋገሯን ይፋ አድርጋለች። ይህ ለውጥ የመጣው ከፍተኛው መሪ ሞጅታባ ካሜኒ በቅርብ ግጭቶች ለተገደሉ ወታደራዊ አዛዦች ምትክ አዳዲስ ሰዎችን ከሾሙ በኋላ ነው። የሀገሪቱ የጦር መሪዎች ይህንን አዲስ ስትራቴጂ በማረጋገጥ፣ በቅርቡ በአካባቢው የተወሰዱ ወታደራዊ እርምጃዎች የዚህ ፖሊሲ አካል መሆናቸውን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Iraan naannoo giddu galeessa bahaatti humnoota Ameerikaarratti harka qabaachuurraa gara weeraraatti cehuuf, imaammata waraana ishee jijjiiruu beeksisiteetti. Jijjiirraan kun kan dhufu, hogganaan ol’aanaan biyyattii Mojtaabaa Kaameeneen ajajoota waraana haaraa bakka warra du’anii bakka buusuun hordofee dha. Ajajoonni waraanaa biyyattii tarkaanfiiwwan naannichatti fudhataman imaammata haaraa kanaan kan burqan ta’uu mirkaneessaniiru.

title: UK withholds information on Israeli firm accused of targeting Scottish first minister in elections
english: The British government has declined to release information regarding an Israeli cybersecurity firm, BlackCore, which has been accused by a French watchdog of interfering in Scottish elections. Officials stated that withholding these details is necessary for national security and to maintain positive foreign relations. While the Scottish government released some internal documents, the UK Cabinet Office insists that disclosing further specifics would jeopardize national interests.
amharic: የብሪታንያ መንግስት በስኮትላንድ ምርጫ ላይ ጣልቃ ገብቷል ተብሎ በተከሰሰው የኢትዮጵያ ሳይበር ደህንነት ኩባንያ ‘ብላክ ኮር’ ላይ ያለውን መረጃ ለመልቀቅ ፈቃደኛ አልሆነም። ባለስልጣናቱ መረጃውን መደበቅ ለብሔራዊ ደህንነት እና ከሌሎች ሀገራት ጋር ያለውን ግንኙነት ለመጠበቅ አስፈላጊ እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል። የስኮትላንድ መንግስት አንዳንድ ሰነዶችን ይፋ ቢያደርግም፣ የዩናይትድ ኪንግደም ካቢኔ ቢሮ ግን ተጨማሪ ዝርዝሮችን ማውጣት ለሀገሪቱ ደህንነት አደገኛ መሆኑን አሳውቋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Britaaniyaa dhaabbata saayibarii Israa'eel 'BlackCore' jedhamu kan filannoo Iskootlandirratti dhiibbaa geessise jedhamee shakkamu irratti ragaa jiru hunda baasuu dideera. Mootummaan kun ragaan kun akka hin baane kan godhe nageenya biyyaa fi hariiroo alaa eeguuf akka ta'e ibseera. Mootummaan Iskootland ragaa tokko tokko kan ifa godhe ta'us, waajjirri kaabinee Britaaniyaa odeeffannoo dabalataa baasuun nageenya biyyaa miidhuu akka danda'u ibsuun ragaicha dhokseera.

title: Five charts that explain the high cost of living in the UK
english: The United Kingdom is facing a significant rise in the cost of living, with inflation remaining high due to increased energy prices. This economic pressure is largely driven by global instability, particularly the conflict involving the US, Israel, and Iran, which has disrupted fuel supplies. Prime Minister Andy Burnham is currently touring the country to address these widespread public concerns regarding the affordability of housing, food, and energy.
amharic: የእንግሊዝ የኑሮ ውድነት በከፍተኛ ደረጃ እየጨመረ ሲሆን በተለይም የነዳጅ ዋጋ ንረት ለዋጋ ግሽበት ዋነኛ ምክንያት ሆኗል። በአሜሪካ፣ በእስራኤል እና በኢራን መካከል ያለው ግጭት የነዳጅ አቅርቦት ላይ ተጽዕኖ በማሳደሩ የትራንስፖርት እና የምግብ ዋጋ እንዲጨምር አድርጓል። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አንዲ በርንሃም የዜጎችን የኑሮ ጫና ለመረዳት እና መፍትሄ ለመፈለግ በሀገሪቱ የጉብኝት መርሃ ግብር ጀምረዋል።
oromo: Biyyi Ingiliz baasii jireenyaa olka'aa ta'e keessa jirti, kunis gatii boba'aa dabaleen guddina gatii meeshaalee (inflation) hammaachiseera. Walitti bu'iinsi gidduu Ameerikaa, Israa'el fi Iraan jiru dhiyeessii boba'aa adunyaa irratti dhiibbaa waan uumeef, gatiin geejjibaa fi nyaataa akka dabalu ta'eera. Muummichi Ministiraa Andi Barnhaam rakkoo kana furuuf jecha hawaasa biyyattii irraa komii fi yaada dhaggeeffachuuf daawwannaa jalqabaniiru.

title: US-Iran talks in deadlock – what’s the latest?
english: Tensions between the US and Iran have escalated as a standoff continues in the Strait of Hormuz, causing a significant drop in global shipping traffic. Iran maintains that it will keep the waterway blocked until the US addresses its demands regarding sanctions and reparations, despite President Trump’s claims of American control. Meanwhile, both nations continue to engage in hostile military actions, including naval blockades and targeted strikes, while diplomatic efforts to reach a peace agreement remain at a standstill.
amharic: በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል ያለው ውጥረት በሆርሙዝ የባህር ዳርቻ ላይ እየተባባሰ በመምጣቱ የአለም አቀፍ የንግድ መርከቦች እንቅስቃሴ በእጅጉ ቀንሷል። ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ የአሜሪካን ሙሉ ቁጥጥር ቢገልጹም፣ ኢራን በአሜሪካ ላይ ያቀረበችው ማዕቀብ እና ካሳ እስኪፈታ ድረስ የባህር ዳርቻውን እንደዘጋች ትቀጥላለች። በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለው ወታደራዊ ግጭት እና የባህር ላይ እገዳዎች የቀጠሉ ሲሆን፣ የሰላም ንግግሮችም በአሁኑ ወቅት ምንም አይነት መፍትሄ ሳይገኙ ተስተጓጉለዋል።
oromo: Waliigalteen dhabamuun walitti buiinsa Ameerikaa fi Iraan gidduu jiru karaan Hormuz akka cufamu gochuun, sochiin dooniiwwan idil-addunyaa akka gadi bu'u taasiseera. Prezidaant Traamp to'annoo Ameerikaa jala akka jiru dubbatanis, Iraan hanga gaaffiin ishee waa'ee sanadaa fi kaffaltii miidhaa deebii argatutti karaan kun akka cufamee turu ibsiteetti. Gama biraan, biyyoonni lameen kutaalee waraanaa fi daangaa daldalaa irratti wal irratti tarkaanfii fudhachuu itti fufanii jiran yoo ta'u, mariin nagaa sadarkaa duraa irratti dhaabbatee jira.

title: Colombia earthquake response tests new far-right government
english: A powerful 7.4 magnitude earthquake recently struck western Colombia, resulting in over 260 deaths and widespread destruction shortly after President Abelardo de la Espriella took office. The government is working to provide emergency aid and financial relief to affected residents while managing the challenges of a difficult political transition from the previous administration. Although rescue efforts are underway in major cities, some remote areas are still struggling with limited resources and basic service outages.
amharic: በቅርቡ በምዕራብ ኮሎምቢያ በተከሰተ 7.4 የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ ከ260 በላይ ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። ፕሬዝዳንት አቤላርዶ ዴ ላ እስፕሪዬላ ስልጣን ከያዙ በኋላ ባጋጠመው በዚህ አደጋ፣ መንግስት የነፍስ አድን ስራዎችን እና ለተጎጂዎች አስቸኳይ እርዳታዎችን ለማድረስ ጥረት እያደረገ ይገኛል። ይሁን እንጂ ከአዲሱ አስተዳደር ጋር በተፈጠረው የፖለቲካ ሽግግር ችግር ምክንያት የአደጋ ጊዜ ምላሹ ፈታኝ ሆኗል፤ አንዳንድ ገጠራማ አካባቢዎችም አሁንም እርዳታ እየጠበቁ ነው።
oromo: Kolombiyaa lixaatti sochiin lafaa hamaan guddina 7.4 qabu mudachuu isaatiin namoonni 260 ol lubbuun isaanii darbeera. Preezdaanti Abelardo de la Espriella aangootti erga dhufanii yeroo gabaabaa booda balaan kun mudachuu isaatiin, mootummaan gargaarsa ariifachiisaa fi deeggarsa maallaqaa hir’uuf qabsaa’aa jira. Haa ta’u malee, ce’umsi siyaasaa mijataa hin taane fi giddu galeessa mootummaa durii wajjin wal qabatee jiru hojii gargaarsaa sana ulfaata taasiseera; naannolee baadiyyaa tokko tokko keessatti gargaarsi fi tajaajilli bu’uuraa ammayyuu hin geenye.

title: More than 135 million people in Europe face temperatures over 35C
english: A severe heatwave is currently hitting Europe, with over 135 million people enduring temperatures exceeding 35C. Nations like the UK and France are struggling with record-breaking heat, leading to critical workplace safety concerns for healthcare staff and widespread drought conditions. As the continent warms faster than any other, governments are under increasing pressure to address the consequences of climate change.
amharic: አውሮፓ በአሁኑ ወቅት ከፍተኛ የሙቀት ማዕበል እየገጠማት ሲሆን ከ135 ሚሊዮን በላይ ሰዎች ከ35 ዲግሪ ሴንቲግሬድ በላይ በሆነ ሙቀት እየተሰቃዩ ይገኛሉ። እንደ እንግሊዝ እና ፈረንሳይ ያሉ አገራት ከመቼውም ጊዜ በላይ በሆነ የሙቀት መጠን እየተፈተኑ ሲሆን ይህም በጤና ባለሙያዎች ላይ የሥራ ደህንነት ስጋትና በውሃ አቅርቦት ላይ ከፍተኛ ድርቅ አስከትሏል። አውሮፓ በዓለም ላይ በፈጣን ሁኔታ እየሞቀች በመሆኗ፣ መንግስታት የአየር ንብረት ለውጥን ለመቋቋም ፈጣን እርምጃዎችን እንዲወስዱ ጫና እየተደረገባቸው ነው።
oromo: Awurooppaan yeroo ammaa kana ho'a cimaa keessa jirti, namoonni miliyoona 135 ol ta'an ho'a digrii seentigrade 35 irraa ol ta'e keessatti dararamaa jiru. Biyyonni akka UK fi Faransaay ho'a seenaa keessatti mul'atee hin beekneen kan rakkatan yoo ta'u, kunis hojjettoota fayyaa irratti rakkoo nageenyaa fi rooba dhabuu irraa kan ka'e rakkoo bishaanii uumeera. Awurooppaan addunyaa irratti bakka saffisaan ho'aa jiru waan ta'eef, mootummoonni jijjiirama qilleensaa kanaan dhufuu danda'u to'achuuf dhiibbaa cimaa keessa jiru.

title: Israel trucks out Gaza’s rubble to ‘hide genocide’ and ‘redraw the map’
english: Human rights organizations report that the Israeli military is systematically removing millions of tons of rubble from the Gaza Strip. Critics argue that this large-scale operation is designed to destroy critical evidence of war crimes and reshape the region's landscape. By moving debris from destroyed homes and cemeteries to undisclosed locations, Israel is accused of attempting to conceal the extent of the humanitarian disaster.

Qeeqtonni tarkaanfiin kun ragaalee yakka waraanaa balleessuufi boca lafa sanaa jijjiiruuf kan karoorfame ta'uu dubbatu. Daaraa mana jigaa fi iddoo awwaalaatii kaasuun gara bakka hin beekamnetti geessuun, Israa'el miidhaa hamaa biyyattii irra ga'e dhoksuuf yaalaa akka jirtu himatamteetti.

title: Iranian press review: Tehran says it will no longer wait to be attacked
english: Iranian military leaders have announced a major shift in their defense strategy, moving from a reactive stance to a more offensive and preemptive approach against US forces. This policy change, reinforced by new leadership appointments, emphasizes launching surprise attacks rather than waiting for direct strikes. Officials have explicitly rejected the idea of a ceasefire, suggesting that Iran may increasingly leverage its control over the Strait of Hormuz to pressure the US and its allies.
amharic: የኢራን ወታደራዊ መሪዎች የመከላከያ ስልታቸውን ሙሉ በሙሉ በመቀየር ከአሁን በኋላ በአሜሪካ ኃይሎች ላይ ጥቃት ከመሰንዘር ወደኋላ እንደማይሉ አስታውቀዋል። ይህ አዲስ አቋም የሚጠበቁ ጥቃቶችን ከመጠበቅ ይልቅ አስቀድሞ እርምጃ በመውሰድና ድንገተኛ ጥቃቶችን በመፈጸም ላይ ያተኩራል። ባለስልጣናቱ ከዩኤስ ጋር ምንም ዓይነት የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት እንደሌለ ገልጸው፣ የሆርሙዝ የባህር ወሽመጥን በመቆጣጠር በአሜሪካ እና በአጋሮቿ ላይ ጫና ለመፍጠር እንደሚጠቀሙበት ፍንጭ ሰጥተዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni waraana Iraan tarsiimoo ittisa biyyattii jijjiiruudhaan, humnoota Amerikaarratti eeggachuu mannaa tarkaanfii dura-dubbii fudhachuu akka jalqaban beeksisaniiru. Jijjiiramni kun waraana eeggachuu mannaa, miira loltummaa cimaa fi tarkaanfii tasaa irratti kan xiyyeeffatu dha. Aantootni biyyattii waldhabdee Amerikaa wajjin jiruuf tasgabbii kamiyyuu akka hin jiraanne ibsuun, daandii galaana Hormuz to'annoo isaanii jala jiru fayyadamuun Amerikaa fi michoota ishee irratti dhiibbaa gochuuf karoorfataniiru.

title: German court ruling on Israel-Nazi comparison is a step in the right direction
english: A German regional court recently ruled that comparing Israel's actions in Gaza to those of Nazi Germany is legally protected speech, overturning a lower court's conviction. This decision challenges the German government's strict efforts to criminalize criticism of Israel using laws intended to prevent Nazi ideology. While the state maintains strong political support for Israel, the ruling acknowledges that such analogies are part of ongoing public and academic debates regarding historical trauma and current conflicts.
amharic: የጀርመን ክልላዊ ፍርድ ቤት የእስራኤልን የጋዛ ድርጊት ከናዚ ጀርመን ጋር ማነፃፀር በህግ የተጠበቀ የመግለፅ ነፃነት እንደሆነ ወስኗል። ይህ ውሳኔ ጀርመን እስራኤልን የሚነቅፉ ሰዎችን በናዚ ዘመን ህግ ለመቅጣት የምታደርገውን ጥረት የሚገዳደር ነው። መንግስት እስራኤልን በፅኑ ቢደግፍም፣ ፍርድ ቤቱ ይህ ዓይነቱ ንፅፅር ታሪካዊ ቁስሎችን እና ወቅታዊ ግጭቶችን በሚመለከት በህዝብ እና በአካዳሚክ ክርክሮች ውስጥ አስፈላጊ አካል እንደሆነ አምኗል።
oromo: Mana murtii naannoo Jarmanii tokko, gocha Israa'el Gaza keessatti raawwattu mootummaa Naazii wajjin wal bira qabuu kun mirga yaada ofii ibsachuu kan seeraan eeggame akka ta'e murteesseera. Murtiin kun mootummaan Jarmanii mormii Israa'el irratti ka'u seera Naazii fayyadamuun adabuuf carraaqu isaa kan mormu dha. Mootummaan kun Israa'eliif gadda guddaa kan qabu ta'us, manni murtichaa wal bira qabdiin akkanaa kun mariiwwan seenaa fi walitti bu'iinsa yeroo ammaa irratti kanneen taasifaman keessatti gahee qabaachuu isaa fudhateera.

title: Ein al-Auja: How settler attacks and water diversion erased a Palestinian community
english: A Palestinian Bedouin community near the Ein al-Auja spring in the West Bank has been forced to abandon their homes due to escalating violence from Israeli settlers and the deliberate cutting off of their water supply. Families, including Haitham Rashaidh’s, were compelled to relocate to remote areas lacking basic services after their once-thriving oasis became uninhabitable. Since 2024, the situation has worsened significantly as new settlement outposts have led to frequent attacks and the systematic destruction of essential infrastructure.
amharic: በዌስት ባንክ የሚገኘው የኢን አል-አውጃ የቤዱዊን ማህበረሰብ በእስራኤል ሰፈራ ሰፋሪዎች የሚደርስባቸው ጥቃት እና የውሃ አቅርቦታቸው በመቋረጡ ምክንያት ቀያቸውን ለቀው ለመውጣት ተገደዋል። የሃይተም ረሻይድን ጨምሮ በርካታ ቤተሰቦች ቀደም ሲል ለኑሯቸው ምቹ የነበረው አካባቢ ለመኖሪያ አስቸጋሪ በመሆኑ ወደ ሩቅ እና መሰረታዊ አገልግሎቶች ወደሌሉባቸው ስፍራዎች ለመሰደድ ተገደዋል። ከ2024 ወዲህ በአካባቢው አዳዲስ ህገ-ወጥ ሰፈሮች መመስረታቸውን ተከትሎ የሚደርሰው ጥቃት እና የውሃ መሰረተ ልማት ውድመት እየተባባሰ በመምጣቱ ማህበረሰቡ ለከፍተኛ ችግር ተጋልጧል።
oromo: Hawaasni Bedouin kan Ein al-Auja keessa jiraatu, weerara irra deddeebi’ee isaan irra gahuu fi dhiyeessii bishaanii isaanirraa kutuun walqabatee lafa isaanii gadhiisanii ba’uuf dirqamaniiru. Maatiin Haitham Rashaidh dabalatee, bakki duriitti jireenya isaaniif mijataa ture kun erga jireenyaaf mijachuu dhabee booda, gara lafa fagoo fi tajaajila bu’uuraa hin qabneetti godaananiiru. Akkaataa bara 2024 irraa eegalee naannichatti iddoowwan qubsumaa seeraan alaa ijaaramuu hordofee, miidhaa isaan irra gahuu fi manca’iinsa bu’uuraalee misooma bishaanii dabaluun hawaasicha rakkoo hamaa keessa buuseera.

title: In Christian village of Taybeh, Israeli military order fails to stop settler violence
english: Residents of the Palestinian village of Taybeh in the West Bank report that recent Israeli military orders declaring their area a closed zone have failed to stop ongoing settler violence. Locals and activists state that settlers continue to harass families, damage property, and seize land despite the military restrictions. Furthermore, there is growing concern that these new closures will hinder journalists and human rights observers from documenting the persistent attacks and displacement of local communities.
amharic: በዌስት ባንክ የምትገኘው የታይቤ መንደር ነዋሪዎች አካባቢው ዝግ መሆኑን የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ትዕዛዝ ቢገልጽም፣ ሰፋሪዎች የሚያደርሱት ጥቃት እንዳልቆመ ተናግረዋል። የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች እና አክቲቪስቶች እንደገለጹት፣ ወታደራዊ እገዳው ቢኖርም ሰፋሪዎች በቤተሰቦች ላይ ጥቃት መፈጸማቸውን፣ ንብረት ማውደማቸውን እና መሬት መውረሳቸውን ቀጥለዋል። በተጨማሪም፣ እነዚህ ገደቦች ጋዜጠኞች እና የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋቾች እየተፈጸመ ያለውን ጥቃት እንዳይዘግቡ እንቅፋት እንደሚፈጥሩ ስጋት ተፈጥሯል።
oromo: jiraattonni baadiyaa Taybeh kan West Bank keessatti argamu, ajajni waraana Israa'el naannicha bakka cufaa ta'ee labsuun isaa haleellaa qondaaltotaa dhaabuu akka hin dandeenye ibsaniiru. Jiraattonnifi aktivistoonni akka jedhanitti, ajaja waraanaa kanaa gaditti illee qondaaltotni maatiiwwan irratti haleellaa raawwachuu, qabeenya mancaasuu fi lafa fudhachuu itti fufaniiru. Kana malees, uggurri kun gaazexeessitootaafi hordoffii mirga namoomaa gootan gochaalee kanneen akka hin galmeessineef gufuu ta'a jedhamee sodaatama.

title: Exclusive: UK Charity Commission gives 'regulatory advice' to synagogue that hosted Great Israeli Real Estate Event
english: The UK Charity Commission has issued formal regulatory advice to the Edgware United Synagogue following a complaint regarding a real estate event held there. The event had promoted property sales in illegal Israeli settlements, leading legal groups to argue that the charity improperly used its resources for controversial commercial activities. The commission has now closed its case, expecting the synagogue's trustees to follow their guidance in the future.
amharic: የእንግሊዝ የበጎ አድራጎት ኮሚሽን በለንደን በሚገኘው ኤጅዌር ዩናይትድ ምኩራብ ላይ የተሰማውን ቅሬታ ተከትሎ መደበኛ የቁጥጥር ምክር ሰጥቷል። ምኩራቡ በህገ-ወጥ የእስራኤል ሰፈራ ውስጥ የሚገኙ ንብረቶችን የሚያስተዋውቅ የሪል እስቴት ዝግጅት ማስተናገዱን ተከትሎ ነው ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው። የህግ ተቋማት የበጎ አድራጎት ድርጅቱ መገልገያዎቹን አግባብ ባልሆነ መንገድ መጠቀሙን በመግለጽ ቅሬታ አቅርበው ነበር። ኮሚሽኑ የምኩራቡ አስተዳዳሪዎች በቀጣይ መመሪያዎቹን እንዲከተሉ በማሳሰብ ጉዳዩን ዘግቶታል።
oromo: Komishiniin Charity UK kan jedhamu, masgiida ykn sinagooga 'Edgware United Synagogue' jedhamu irratti erga komiin dhiyaatee booda gorsa seeraa kennuuf dirqameera. Kunis masgiidichi iddoowwan seeraan alaa kanneen Israa'el qabatte keessatti qabeenya gurguruu fi babal'isuuf qophiin daldalaa akka gaggeeffamu waan heyyameef kan dhufedha. Gareewwan mirga namaa dhaabbanni kun qabeenya isaa hojii wal-falmiisisaa ta'eef akka oolche himatanii turan. Komishinichi dhimma kana erga qorate booda, bulchitoota sinagoogichaa gorsa gadi fageenyaan erga kenne booda galmee dhimma kanaa cufuun beekameera.

title: Travis Kelce shares first details from his wedding to Taylor Swift: 'Best night of my life'
english: NFL star Travis Kelce recently opened up about his private July wedding to singer Taylor Swift, which took place at Madison Square Garden. He described the star-studded event, officiated by actor Adam Sandler, as the highlight of his life. The couple has kept the details of their marriage largely private, choosing not to release official photographs from the celebration.

oromo: Taphataan kubbaa miillaa NFL Traavis Kelsee ji'a Adooleessaa keessa sirna cidha isaa kan sirbituu Teylar Siwiftii wajjin iddoo Maadiisan Iskuweer Gaardinii keessatti gaggeeffame ilaalchisee yaada isaa ibseera. title: Eurovision to bar countries at war from hosting: What that means
english: The European Broadcasting Union has introduced a new policy that prevents countries involved in active armed conflicts or geopolitical instability from hosting the Eurovision Song Contest. While affected nations can still participate as contestants, they will no longer be permitted to serve as the host country for the annual event. Organizers will now conduct independent security assessments to determine if a winning country is fit to host, or if an alternative location must be selected.
amharic: የአውሮፓ የብሮድካስቲንግ ህብረት በጦርነት ወይም በጂኦፖለቲካዊ አለመረጋጋት ውስጥ ያሉ ሀገራት የዩሮቪዥን የዘፈን ውድድርን እንዳያስተናግዱ የሚከለክል አዲስ ደንብ አውጥቷል። እነዚህ ሀገራት በውድድሩ ላይ ተሳታፊ መሆን ቢችሉም፣ የአስተናጋጅነት መብታቸውን ግን ያጣሉ። ውድድሩን የሚያዘጋጀው አካል የአሸናፊ ሀገራትን የደህንነት ሁኔታ በመገምገም ውድድሩ በዚያ ቦታ ይካሄድ ወይም ሌላ አማራጭ ቦታ ይመረጥ የሚለውን ይወስናል።
oromo: Gamtaan Raadiyoofi Televizhinii Awurooppaa, biyyoota waraana ykn rakkoo siyaasaa keessa jiran sirna waldorgommii sirba 'Eurovision' akka hin qindeessine dhorkaa haaraa baaseera. Biyyoonni kunniin waldorgommii kana keessatti hirmaachuu kan danda'an ta'us, qindeessitoota ykn keessummeessitoota ta'uu hin danda'an. Qindeessitoonni dorgommichaa biyya mootee keessaatti tasgabbiin jiraachuu isaa erga qoratanii booda, qophiin sun achitti akka gaggeeffamu ykn iddoo biraatti akka jijjiiramu murteessu.

title: UK defends seizing shadow fleet tanker after Putin threat
english: The British government has upheld its decision to seize a Russian oil tanker suspected of violating international sanctions used to fund the war in Ukraine. President Vladimir Putin condemned the action as piracy and threatened to retaliate against Western vessels in any location. In response, UK officials stated the operation was conducted legally to disrupt Russia's illicit shadow fleet.

oromo: Mootummaan Britaan doonii boba'aa Raashiyaa kan seera addunyaa cabsitee waraana Yuukireeniif maallaqa argamsiisaa jirtu jedhamtu qabachuun ishee sirrii ta'uu ibsite. Preezidaant Vilaadimiir Puutin tarkaanfii kana akka saaminsaatti ibsuun, iddoo barbaadanitti dooniiwwan biyyoota dhihaa irratti haaloo bahachuuf akka kaka'an doorsisaniiru. Gamasaatiin, mootummaan Britaan tarkaanfichi kan fudhatame seera idil-addunyaa kabajuun fi sharafa seeraan alaa kan Raashiyaa gufachiisuuf ta'uu beeksiseera.

title: Russell Westbrook announces NBA retirement after 18 seasons
english: NBA superstar Russell Westbrook has officially retired from professional basketball after an impressive 18-year career. Known as the league's all-time leader in triple-doubles, the former MVP earned numerous honors, including nine All-Star selections and an Olympic gold medal. Over his extensive time on the court with seven different teams, he cemented his legacy as one of the most dynamic and competitive athletes in basketball history.
amharic: የኤንቢኤ ኮከብ ተጫዋች ራስል ዌስትብሩክ ለ18 ዓመታት ከቆየው የቅርጫት ኳስ ህይወቱ በይፋ ጡረታ መውጣቱን አስታውቋል። በሊጉ ታሪክ ከፍተኛውን የ'ትሪፕል-ዳብል' ክብረ ወሰን የያዘው የቀድሞው የምርጥ ተጫዋች (MVP) ተሸላሚ፣ ዘጠኝ ጊዜ በአል-ስታር ጨዋታ ላይ የተሳተፈ እና የኦሎምፒክ የወርቅ ሜዳሊያ ባለቤት ነው። በሰባት የተለያዩ ቡድኖች ውስጥ በነበረው ረጅም የጨዋታ ጊዜ፣ በቅርጫት ኳስ ታሪክ ውስጥ እጅግ ተወዳዳሪ እና ጉልበት ካላቸው ተጫዋቾች አንዱ በመሆን ስሙን አስጠራቷል።
oromo: Leemantuun kubbaa kashaa NBA Rasel Weestbruuk waggaa 18 booda hojii isaa kan gadi lakkise ta'uu beeksiseera. Weestbruuk seenaa NBA keessatti rekodii 'triple-double' baay'ee qabaachuun isaa kan beekamu yoo ta'u, kanaan dura goota taphattootaa (MVP) ta'uun isaas ni yaadatama. Garee torba adda addaa keessatti taphachuudhaan, kutaannoo fi dandeettii isaatiin taphattoota seenaa kubbaa kashaa keessatti maqaa guddaa qaban keessaa tokko ta'uun injifateera.

title: Life and loss as a first responder in southern Lebanon
english: Ali Safiuddin, the head of Civil Defence in Tyre, Lebanon, continues his rescue work despite enduring the personal tragedy of losing his young daughter during the 2006 conflict. While the city itself remains relatively stable, he frequently deals with the impact of ongoing strikes in nearby border areas. His traumatic past drives his commitment to saving others, as he views every life he rescues as a way to honor his daughter's memory.
amharic: የሊባኖስ ቲር ከተማ የሲቪል መከላከያ ሃላፊ የሆኑት አሊ ሳፊዲን፣ በ2006 ዓ.ም ግጭት ሴት ልጃቸውን በሞት በማጣታቸው ከደረሰባቸው የግል ሃዘን ጋር በመታገል የነፍስ አድን ስራቸውን ይቀጥላሉ። ምንም እንኳን የከተማዋ ሁኔታ አንጻራዊ መረጋጋት ቢኖረውም፣ በአቅራቢያው በሚገኙ ድንበር አካባቢዎች በሚፈጸሙ ጥቃቶች ሳቢያ ከፍተኛ ስራ ይጠብቃቸዋል። ሳፊዲን በህይወት የሚያድኗቸው እያንዳንዱ ሰው የልጃቸውን ትውስታ እንደሚታደሱ ስለሚሰማቸው ለስራቸው ልዩ ትኩረት ይሰጣሉ።
oromo: Hogganaan dhaabbata ittisa sivilii magaalaa Xuur kan Libaanoos Alii Safiiddiin, intala isaa xiqqa yeroo waraana bara 2006 dhabuun gadda guddaa keessa darbuus hojii fayyisa lubbuu itti fufeera. Magaalli sun hanga tokko nagaa ta'us, naannawwaa daangaa kanatti haleellaan yeroo gara yerootti waan raawwatamuuf itti gaafatamummaan isaa guddaadha. Inni namoota fayyisuun lubbuu intala isaa yaadachuu akka ta'e waan amanuuf, hojii isaa kana jabeessee itti fufa.

title: What postcolonialism looks like in Southeast Asia
english: The article explores the ongoing influence and legacy of colonial history within Southeast Asian nations. It examines how these countries are navigating their postcolonial identities and addressing the lingering impacts of past foreign rule. Through a series of discussions, the piece highlights the complex political and social challenges that continue to shape the region today.
amharic: ጽሁፉ በደቡብ ምስራቅ እስያ ሀገራት ላይ የቅኝ ግዛት ታሪክ በዘመናችን ስላለው ተጽዕኖ ይዳስሳል። እነዚህ ሀገራት ከቅኝ ግዛት ነጻ ከወጡ በኋላ የራሳቸውን ማንነት በመገንባት ሂደት ውስጥ ያሉትን ፈተናዎች እና ያለፈው የውጭ ሀገራት አስተዳደር ትቶት ያለፈውን አሻራ ይገመግማል። በውይይቶቹ አማካኝነት የክልሉን ፖለቲካዊ እና ማህበራዊ ሁኔታዎች የሚቀርጹ ውስብስብ ጉዳዮች ተብራርተዋል።
oromo: Barruun kun dhiibbaa seenaa koloniyaalizimii fi duubbee isaa kan biyyoota Kibba-baha Eeshiyaa irratti xiyyeeffata. Biyyoonni kun eenyummaa isaanii kan booda-koloniyaalii ijaaruuf akkamitti akka carraaqaa jiran fi dhiibbaa bulchiinsa alagaa kan darbe sanas akkamitti akka waliin jiraataa jiran qorata. Mariiwwan garagaraa kanaanis, rakkoowwan siyaasaa fi hawaasummaa kanneen har'a naannichaa bocaa jiran ibsa.

title: Japan protests as Russia’s Putin visits disputed Kuril Islands
english: Russian President Vladimir Putin recently visited the Kuril Islands, a territory Japan claims as its own since the Soviet Union seized them in 1945. Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi condemned the trip as unacceptable, stating that the islands are historically Japanese territory. This visit further strained diplomatic relations between Tokyo and Moscow, which have already deteriorated due to Japan's support for Ukraine in the ongoing conflict.
amharic: የሩሲያው ፕሬዝዳንት ቭላዲሚር ፑቲን እ.ኤ.አ በ1945 በሶቪየት ህብረት ከተያዙ እና ጃፓን የራሷ ግዛት እንደሆኑ በምትከራከርባቸው የኩሪል ደሴቶች ላይ ጉብኝት አድርገዋል። የጃፓን ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ሳናኤ ታካይቺ ደሴቶቹ በታሪክ የጃፓን አካል መሆናቸውን በመግለጽ ጉብኝቱን አጥብቀው ተቃውመዋል። ይህ ድርጊት በዩክሬን ጦርነት ምክንያት ቀድሞውኑ የተበላሸውን የሁለቱን ሀገራት ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነት የበለጠ አባብሶታል።
oromo: Pirezedantiin Raashiyaa Vladimir Puutin daawwannaa seena qabeessa ta'e kan inni godhe, bakkawwan bara 1945 irraa jalqabee Jaappaan kan kiyya jettu ganda Kuril jedhamutti. Muummichi ministeeraa Jaappaan Sanae Takaichi, daawwannaa kana akka hin fudhatamneefi bakkichis biyya isaanii ta'uu ibsuun balaaleffataniiru. Gochi kun hariiroo dippilomaasii Raashiyaafi Jaappaan gidduu jiru kan waraana Yuukireen irratti hundaa'e caalaatti kan hammeesse ta'uu gabaasameera.

title: Singapore-flagged container ship crashes into riverbank in India
english: A cargo ship registered in Singapore ran aground along the Hooghly River in eastern India. The incident occurred after the vessel experienced mechanical issues with its steering system while en route to the port of Kolkata. Authorities are currently managing the situation following the accidental collision with the riverbank.

oromo: Markaan fe'umsaa kan Singaporitti galmaa'e tokko gara baha Indiyaatti laga Huughlii cinaatti cabee bu'e. Rakkoon kun kan mudate yeroo markattiin sun gara buufata Kolkaataatti imalaa jirtetti sirna harka-kaachisuu (steering) ishee irratti rakkoon muudatee dha. Abbootiin taayitaa erga markattiin sun cina lafa lagaatti guuftee booda haala jiru to'achaa jiru.

title: US visa sanctions expose the limits of diplomatic pragmatism
english: The U.S. government is facing criticism for imposing visa restrictions on TPLF leaders, with critics arguing that this move prioritizes political convenience over essential justice for victims of atrocities. The author contends that ignoring accountability for genocide undermines the potential for a lasting peace in Ethiopia. By targeting those who demand justice and adherence to peace agreements, the U.S. is accused of betraying its own values and neglecting the necessity of truth in post-conflict transitions.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት በህወሓት መሪዎች ላይ የቪዛ ማዕቀብ መጣሉ ትችት እየገጠመው ነው። ተቺዎች ይህ ውሳኔ ለተፈጸሙ ግፍ ሰለባዎች ትክክለኛ ፍትህ ከመስጠት ይልቅ ለፖለቲካዊ ምቾት ቅድሚያ የሚሰጥ ነው ይላሉ። ደራሲው የዘር ማጥፋት ወንጀልን ተጠያቂነት ችላ ማለት በኢትዮጵያ ዘላቂ ሰላም ለመፍጠር የሚያስችል እድልን ያዳክማል ሲሉ ይከራከራሉ። አሜሪካ ፍትህን የሚጠይቁትን በመቅጣት የራሷን እሴቶች እንደከዳች እና ከግጭት በኋላ የሚመጣውን የሽግግር ሂደት አስፈላጊ እውነታ ችላ እንዳለች ይገልጻሉ።
oromo: Mootummaan Amerikaa hoggantoota TPLF irratti uggura viizaa kaa'uun isaa qeeqa jabaa hordofsiiseera. Qeeqtoonni akka jedhanitti, tarkaanfiin kun miidhaa raawwatameef haqaa dhugaa kennuu irra faayidaa siyaasaa dura dursa kenna. Barreessaan kun akka jedhutti, duguuginsa sanyii raawwatameef itti gaafatamummaa dhabamsiisuun nagaa waaraa Itoophiyaa keessatti fiduu hin danda'u. Amerikaan haqaa fi kabajaa waliigaltee nagaa gaafatan irratti tarkaanfii fudhachuun, duudhaalee ofii ishee akka gantee fi dhuga-ba'ii fi haqaa aadaa cehuumsa keessatti barbaachisu akka tuffatte ibsameera.

title: FIFA’s Infantino backed by six Arab federations including Qatar and Morocco
english: FIFA President Gianni Infantino has received a significant boost as six Arab football federations, including Qatar and Morocco, publicly declared their support for his leadership. This endorsement comes while Infantino faces calls to resign from major global confederations following a failed plan to secure private investment for FIFA. Despite this internal pressure ahead of next year's election, these key nations remain committed to his vision for developing the sport.
amharic: የፊፋ ፕሬዝዳንት ጃኒ ኢንፋንቲኖ በኳታር እና ሞሮኮን ጨምሮ በስድስት የአረብ ሀገራት እግር ኳስ ፌዴሬሽኖች ድጋፍ አግኝተዋል። ይህ ድጋፍ የተሰጠው ኢንፋንቲኖ ለፊፋ ውድድሮች የግል ኢንቨስትመንት ለማስገባት ያቀረቡት ሀሳብ በመክሸፉ ምክንያት በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ከባድ ተቃውሞ እየገጠማቸው ባለበት ወቅት ነው። ለሚቀጥለው ዓመት ምርጫ እየተዘጋጁ ያሉትን ፕሬዝዳንቱን እነዚህ አገራት በስልጣን ላይ እንዲቆዩ ያላቸውን እምነት በይፋ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin FIFA Jaanni Iinfaantiinoo biyyoota Arabaa ja'a, kanneen akka Kaataar fi Moroookoo dabalatee, deeggarsa isaanii argataniiru. Deeggarsi kun kan dhufe, Iinfaantiinoon sagantaa FIFA keessatti investimantii dhuunfaa galchuuf qaban erga fashaleen booda, qondaaltota kubbaa miillaa idil-addunyaa biraa irraa dhiibbaan cimaan isaan irratti ka'ee jirutti. Akkuma gara fuulduraatti filannoon geggeeffamuuf jiruun, biyyoonni kun hojiin isaanii fi gaggeessummaan isaanii kan itti fufu ta'uu ibsaniiru.

title: Pro-Palestine activists smear red paint on Danish defence company
english: Pro-Palestine demonstrators defaced the offices of Terma, a Danish defense manufacturer, by covering the building in red paint. The protesters targeted the firm to voice their opposition to its alleged role in supplying weaponry used during the conflict in Gaza. This act of vandalism was intended as a protest against the company's military production ties.
amharic: የፍልስጤም ደጋፊ አክቲቪስቶች በዴንማርክ የጦር መሳሪያ አምራች ኩባንያ ተርማ (Terma) ላይ ቀይ ቀለም በመቀባት ተቃውሟቸውን አሳይተዋል። ተቃዋሚዎቹ ኩባንያው በጋዛ በሚካሄደው ጦርነት ጥቅም ላይ በሚውሉ የጦር መሳሪያዎች ትርፍ እያገኘ ነው በማለት ተችተዋል። ይህ ድርጊት የኩባንያውን ወታደራዊ የንግድ እንቅስቃሴ ለመቃወም የተደረገ ነው።
oromo: Deeggartoonni Falasxiin biyya Deenmaark keessatti argamu dhaabbata meeshaa waraanaa oomishu kan Terma jedhamu irratti gubbee diimaa dibuun mormii isaanii ibsataniiru. Mormitootni kun, dhaabbatichi waraana Gaaza keessatti meeshaalee waraanaa fayyadaman irraa bu'aa argata jedhanii komatu. Gochi kun dhaabbatichi hojii waraanaatiin walqabatee raawwatu mormuuf kan raawwatame dha.

title: Bangladesh humble Australia with worst total in contest as Hasan takes 6-55
english: Bangladesh dominated the first day of their Test match against Australia in Darwin by bowling the hosts out for just 198 runs. Hasan Mahmud delivered a career-best performance, claiming six wickets to help restrict the Australians to their lowest-ever total against Bangladesh. By the end of the day, the visitors responded strongly, reaching 96-1 and trailing by only 102 runs.
amharic: ባንግላዲሽ በዳርዊን በተካሄደው የሙከራ ግጥሚያ የመጀመሪያ ቀን አውስትራሊያን በ198 ሩጫ ብቻ በመገደብ አስደናቂ ብቃት አሳይታለች። ሃሰን ማህሙድ ስድስት ውድ የሆኑ ዊኬቶችን በመውሰድ አውስትራሊያ ከባንግላዲሽ ጋር ካደረገችው ጨዋታዎች በታችኛው የውጤት መጠን እንዲያበቁ አድርጓል። ቀኑ ሲጠናቀቅ የባንግላዲሽ ተጫዋቾች 96 ሩጫ በማግኘት በአውስትራሊያ ላይ ጠንካራ ጫና ፈጥረዋል።
oromo: Bangladesh guyyaa jalqabaa qormaata ishee Australia waliin Darwinitti taasisteen taphattoota Australia fiigicha 198 qofa irratti dhaabuu dandeesseetti. Hasan Mahmud wiciiketii ja'a fudhachuun qabxii isaa olaanaa galmeessiseera, kunis Australia qabxii hanga ammaatti Bangladesh waliin taphatte keessatti argatte keessaa isa gad-aanaa akka ta'u taasiseera. Guyyaan yeroo xumuramu, Bangladesh fiigicha 96 argachuun Australia irratti carraa gaarii qabdi.

title: Photos: Hope fades in Colombia as teams dig for earthquake survivors
english: A massive 7.4 magnitude earthquake has struck western Colombia, resulting in at least 265 deaths and thousands of injuries. Rescue teams are working tirelessly through debris in search of nearly 500 missing individuals, though expectations for finding survivors are decreasing as time passes. The government has declared a state of emergency and national mourning as citizens gather in temporary shelters for support.
amharic: በምዕራብ ኮሎምቢያ በተከሰተው የ7.4 ማግኒቲዩድ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ ቢያንስ 265 ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል፣ ከ3,500 በላይ የሚሆኑት ደግሞ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። የነፍስ አድን ሰራተኞች አሁንም ከ500 በላይ የጠፉ ሰዎችን በፍርስራሽ ስር እየፈለጉ ቢሆንም፣ በህይወት የመገኘት ተስፋ እየቀነሰ መጥቷል። መንግስት በአገሪቱ የአስቸኳይ ጊዜ አዋጅ ማወጁን ተከትሎ፣ የተጎዱ ዜጎች ጊዜያዊ መጠለያዎችን በመጠቀም ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Kolombiyaa lixaatti lafti socho’uu isaa hordofee namoonni 265 ol lubbuun isaanii darbeera, kuma sadii ol immoo miidhaniiru. Gareen gargaarsa namoomaa namoota 500 ol ta’an kan hin argamin bakka caccabaa keessatti barbaacha jiruus, abdii lubbuun argachuu hir’achaa dhufeera. Mootummaan biyyattii hatattamaa ta’ee fi gadda biyyoolessaa kan labse yoo ta’u, namoonni miidhaman qubannaa yeroo keessa jiraachaa jiru.

title: US diplomat calls Israeli settler siege of West Bank homes ‘act of terror’
english: US Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee has condemned an ongoing blockade of Palestinian homes in the West Bank village of Qusra by Israeli settlers as an act of terror. The settlers have cut off essential supplies like water and electricity to three families, including one with American citizenship, in an attempt to force them from their land. Despite initial attempts by Israeli security forces to clear the area, the families remain trapped and are refusing to abandon their properties.
amharic: የአሜሪካ አምባሳደር ማይክ ሃክቢ በእስራኤል ሰፈራ ሰፋሪዎች በዌስት ባንክ ቁስራ መንደር የሚገኙ የፍልስጤም ቤተሰቦች ላይ እየተፈጸመ ያለውን ከበባ እንደ ሽብርተኝነት ድርጊት አውግዘዋል። ሰፋሪዎቹ ውሃ እና ኤሌክትሪክን ጨምሮ መሰረታዊ አቅርቦቶችን በማቋረጥ ቤተሰቦቹን ከቀያቸው ለማፈናቀል እየሞከሩ ይገኛሉ፤ ከነዚህ ቤተሰቦች መካከል የአሜሪካ ዜግነት ያላቸውም ይገኙበታል። የእስራኤል የጸጥታ ኃይሎች ሰፋሪዎቹን ለማስለቀቅ ሙከራ ቢያደርጉም፣ ቤተሰቦቹ ቤታቸውን ለመልቀቅ ፈቃደኛ ሳይሆኑ አሁንም በእግድ ውስጥ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Ambaasaaddarri Ameerikaa Israa'elitti argaman Maayik Hakbii, qe'ee qonnaan bultoota Israa'el naannoo Qusraa ishee Qarqara Lixaatti maatiiwwan Falasxiin irratti gochaa jiran kan 'shororkeessummaa' ta'uu ibsanii jiru. Qonnaan bultoonni kunneen maatiiwwan sadii, kanneen keessaas lammiilee Ameerikaa jiran, bishaan, ibsaa fi meeshaalee barbaachisoo irraa kutuun lafa isaanii irraa ari'uuf yaalaa jiru. Humnoonni nageenyaa Israa'el qonnaan bultoota kana achi baasuuf yaalii taasisanillee, maatiiwwan kun iddoo isaanii gadhiisuu diduun ammas achuma keessatti hidhamanii jiru.

title: Pentagon tells Congress US killed 153 civilians in Yemen air strikes
english: A recent Pentagon report submitted to Congress reveals that US military operations in Yemen during 2025 resulted in 153 civilian deaths and 243 injuries. These airstrikes were launched following President Trump's order to target Houthi forces in response to their attacks on Red Sea shipping. The document specifically highlighted high-casualty incidents in Sanaa and Hodeidah, with some actions facing calls for war crime investigations.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መከላከያ ሚኒስቴር ለኮንግረስ ባቀረበው ሪፖርት መሠረት፣ ባለፈው ዓመት በየመን በተካሄዱ የአየር ጥቃቶች 153 ንጹሃን ዜጎች መገደላቸውንና 243 መቁሰላቸውን አስታውቋል። እነዚህ ጥቃቶች የተፈጸሙት በቀይ ባህር የንግድ መርከቦች ላይ በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ለሚደርሰው ጥቃት ምላሽ ለመስጠት ነው። ሪፖርቱ በሳንዓ እና በሁዳይዳ የተፈጸሙ ገዳይ ጥቃቶችን በዝርዝር የገለጸ ሲሆን፣ በአንዳንድ ክስተቶች ላይ የጦር ወንጀል ምርመራ እንዲደረግ ጥሪ ቀርቧል።
oromo: Gabaasni Ministeera Ittisa Biyyaa Ameerikaa gara Koongiresiitti ergame akka mul'isutti, bara darbe Yemen keessatti haleellaa qilleensaa Ameerikaan gaggeessiteen namoonni nagaa 153 du'anii 243 ammoo madaa'aniiru. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame loltoonni Huutii markaboota galaana diimaa keessa jiran irratti haleellaa waan raawwataniif Pirezidaant Traamp ajaja kennanii dha. Gabaasichi magaalaalee Sanaa fi Hodeidaa keessatti haleellaa ga'e ibsuudhaan, gochoota tokko tokko irratti qorannoon yakka waraanaa akka gaggeeffamu gaafatameera.

title: Gaza death toll reaches 73,389
english: The Palestinian health ministry reports that recent Israeli strikes in the Gaza Strip have resulted in at least one death and seven injuries. This latest violence adds to the ongoing conflict that began in October 2023. Current records indicate that the total number of Palestinians killed has now climbed to over 73,000, with more than 174,000 people wounded.
amharic: የፍልስጤም ጤና ሚኒስቴር እንደገለጸው በእስራኤል በጋዛ ሰርጥ በተፈጸመ የቅርብ ጊዜ ጥቃት ቢያንስ አንድ ሰው ሲሞት ሰባት ሰዎች ቆስለዋል። ይህ ጥቃት ከጥቅምት 2016 ዓ.ም ጀምሮ እየተካሄደ ያለውን ግጭት ተከትሎ የመጣ ነው። አሁን ባለው መረጃ መሰረት በጋዛ የሟቾች ቁጥር ከ73,000 በላይ የደረሰ ሲሆን ከ174,000 በላይ ሰዎች ደግሞ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል።
oromo: Ministeerri Fayyaa Filisxeem akka gabaasetti, haleellaa Israa'el daangaa Gaazaa keessatti raawwatte kanaan namni tokko yoo du'u, torban immoo madaa'aniiru. Haleellaan kun waraana Adoolessa 2023 jalqabee itti fufe keessatti kan dabalameedha. Akka ragaa amma jiruutti, lakkoofsi namoota du'anii 73,000 kan caale yoo ta'u, namoonni 174,000 ol ta'an immoo miidhaan irra ga'eera.

title: Mecca Defence Agreement will include political and military coordination, Turkey says
english: Turkey, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan have established a new defense agreement that focuses on closer political and military collaboration. This partnership involves high-level meetings between the nations' defense and foreign officials alongside their military leaders. The alliance aims to organize joint military drills and foster cooperation in defense manufacturing and technological development.
amharic: ቱርክ፣ ሳውዲ አረቢያ እና ፓኪስታን በፖለቲካ እና በወታደራዊ ዘርፍ የጠበቀ ትብብር ለማድረግ የሚያስችል አዲስ የመከላከያ ስምምነት ተፈራርመዋል። ስምምነቱ የሦስቱን ሀገራት የመከላከያና የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትሮች እንዲሁም የጦር አዛዦች ያካተተ የምክክር መድረክ ይፈጥራል። አጋርነቱ በጋራ ወታደራዊ ልምምዶችን ለማከናወን እና በመከላከያ ኢንዱስትሪና ቴክኖሎጂ ሽግግር ላይ በጋራ ለመስራት ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Turkey, Saudi Arabia fi Pakistan waligaltee ittisaa haaraa kan siyaasaa fi waraanaan walitti dhiyeenya uumu mallatteessaniiru. Waligalteen kun ministiroota ittisaa, ministiroota dhimma alaa fi qondaaltota waraanaa biyyoota sadanii walitti fiduun kan qophaaye dha. Tumsi kun leenjii waraanaa waliinii gaggeessuu fi oomisha meeshaalee waraanaa akkasumas guddina teeknooloojii irratti walta'iinsaan hojjechuuf kan karoorfate dha.

title: Salvage operation for stricken tanker off Omani coast begins
english: A salvage operation is underway to stabilize the Caroline Bezengi, a Cameroon-flagged tanker that has been stranded off the coast of Oman since early June following an unexplained explosion. Environmental authorities have confirmed that oil from the vessel has already polluted approximately 40 kilometers of the Omani shoreline. Western officials believe the ship is involved in transporting sanctioned Russian oil, raising concerns about a potential large-scale environmental disaster.
amharic: ሰኔ መጀመሪያ ላይ ያልታወቀ ፍንዳታ የገጠማት የካሜሮን ባንዲራ የምታውለበልበው የነዳጅ መጫኛ መርከብ በኦማን የባህር ጠረፍ ላይ በመቆሟ የነፍረ-አድን ስራ እየተከናወነ ይገኛል። የኦማን የአካባቢ ጥበቃ ባለስልጣናት ከመርከቧ የፈሰሰው ነዳጅ ወደ 40 ኪሎ ሜትር የሚጠጋውን የባህር ጠረፍ መበከሉን አረጋግጠዋል። ምዕራባውያን መንግስታት መርከቧ የሩሲያን ማዕቀብ የተጣለበትን ነዳጅ ለማጓጓዝ የምትጠቀምበት የጥላ መርከቦች ቡድን አካል እንደሆነች በመግለጽ፣ ሁኔታው መጠነ ሰፊ የአካባቢ ጥፋት ሊያስከትል እንደሚችል ስጋት ፈጥረዋል።
oromo: Markabii gosa 'Caroline Bezengi' jedhamu kan alaabaa Kaameruun qabateefi ji'a Waxabajjii keessa balaa dhohiinsaatiin ganda Omaanitti dhaabbate tasgabbeessuuf hojiin fayyinsaa eegalameera. Abbootiin taayitaa naannichaa akka mirkaneessanitti, dhangala'aan boba'aa markabicha keessaa ba'e qarqara galaana Omaan hamma kiilomeetira 40 ta'u faaleera. Mootummoonni lixaa markabni kun boba'aa Raashiyaa irratti tateen jiru guuruuf kan gargaaramaniifi garee 'shadow fleet' jedhamu keessaa akka ta'e dubbatanis, balaa naannoo guddaa qaqqabsiisuu danda'a jedhanii yaaddoo qabu.

title: Maersk CEO says conditions right to increase transit through Suez
english: Maersk's CEO expects the shipping giant to resume full transit through the Suez Canal by 2026, provided that security in Yemen remains stable. While the company recently reported strong financial results, it continues to monitor regional threats posed by Houthi attacks in the Red Sea. Along with partner Hapag-Lloyd, Maersk will gradually evaluate safety before finalizing its return to this critical trade route.
amharic: የማርስክ ዋና ስራ አስፈፃሚ በየመን ያለው የፀጥታ ሁኔታ የተረጋጋ ከሆነ ኩባንያው እ.ኤ.አ በ2026 ሙሉ በሙሉ በስዊዝ ቦይ በኩል መጓጓዣውን ለመቀጠል እንዳቀደ ገልጸዋል። ኩባንያው ጠንካራ የገቢ ውጤቶችን እያስመዘገበ ቢሆንም በቀይ ባህር ውስጥ በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች የሚደርሱትን ጥቃቶች በቅርበት እየተከታተለ ይገኛል። ከባልደረባዋ ሀፓግ-ሎይድ ጋር በመሆን ለደህንነት ሲባል የጉዞ መስመሩን ሁኔታ በጥንቃቄ እየገመገሙ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Hogganaan olaanaa dhaabbata Maersk akka ibsetti, yoo haalli nageenyaa Yamanitti tasgabbaa’e, dhaabbatichi bara 2026 irraa eegalee daandii bishaan Suez guutumaan guutuutti fayyadamuu akka jalqabu abdii qaba. Dhaabbatichi bu’aa kaffaltii cimaa galmeessisus, haleellaa garee Huutii kan Galaana Diimaa keessatti raawwatamu hordofaa jira. Maersk dhaabbata Hapag-Lloyd wajjin ta’uun, nageenya qorachuun daandii daldalaa kanaatti deebi’uuf qophii taasisaa jira.

title: National Bank Forces Anbesa Bank Board Re-run, All Incumbents Out
english: The National Bank of Ethiopia mandated a new board election for Anbesa Bank after rejecting the previous results due to internal conflicts that threatened the institution's stability. During a supervised assembly held on August 8, 2026, shareholders voted for an entirely new group of 11 directors, removing all members of the former board. This leadership overhaul is intended to resolve long-standing disputes and ensure better governance for the bank and its depositors.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ ብሄራዊ ባንክ በአንበሳ ባንክ የቀድሞ የቦርድ ምርጫ ላይ አለመግባባቶች በመፈጠሩ እና የባንኩን ደህንነት ስጋት ላይ በመጣሉ ምርጫው እንዲደገም አዟል። በዚህም መሰረት ነሐሴ 8 ቀን 2026 በተካሄደው ስብሰባ ባለአክሲዮኖች 11 አዳዲስ የቦርድ አባላትን በመምረጥ የነበሩትን ሙሉ በሙሉ አንስተዋል። ይህ አዲስ አመራር የባንኩን የአስተዳደር ችግሮች ለመፍታት እና ለተቀማጮች መረጋጋት ለማምጣት ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Baankiin Biyyaalessaa Itoophiyaa, walitti buiinsa keessoo baankichaaf sodaachisaa ta'e hordofee, filannoon boordii Baankii Anbasaa duraanii akka haquufi irra deebi'amee akka gaggeeffamu ajaje. Fulbaana 8, 2026 walgahii addaa gaggeeffameen, qooda fudhattoonni miseensota boordii 11 haaraa filachuun miseensota boordii duraanii hunda bakka buusaniiru. Jijjiiramni gaggeessummaa kun rakkoolee bulchiinsa baankichaa furuufi nageenya qusattootaa eeguuf kan gargaaruudha.

title: The Storm Passed, the Freight Bill Did Not
english: A Bishoftu-based flower farm, Vegpro, has successfully recovered from a devastating storm that destroyed its greenhouses last year. However, the business is now facing a new crisis due to significant spikes in global shipping and transportation costs caused by regional instability. These rising freight prices are severely straining the company's thin profit margins, as it struggles to remain competitive in the European flower market.
amharic: ቢሾፍቱ የሚገኘው ቬግፕሮ የተባለ የአበባ እርሻ ከአንድ ዓመት በፊት በደረሰው አውሎ ንፋስ የደረሰበትን ጉዳት አስተካክሎ ወደ ስራ ቢመለስም አሁን ደግሞ በዓለም አቀፍ የጭነት ማጓጓዣ ዋጋ መናር ምክንያት ሌላ ፈተና ገጥሞታል። በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ባለው አለመረጋጋት የተነሳ የትራንስፖርት ወጪዎች በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ መጨመራቸው የኩባንያውን ትርፍ በእጅጉ እየጎዳው ይገኛል። አነስተኛ የትርፍ ህዳግ ባለው የአበባ ገበያ ውስጥ የሚንቀሳቀሰው ይህ ድርጅት፣ አሁን ካለው የዋጋ ጭማሪ ጋር ተያይዞ በአውሮፓ ገበያ ተወዳዳሪ ሆኖ ለመቀጠል እየተቸገረ ይገኛል።
oromo: Qonnaan beeytii abaaboo Bishoftuutti argamtu kan Vegpro jedhamtu, ganna darbe bubbeen maasii ishee irratti miidhaa erraan gahee booda deebitee haala gaariin ijaarramtee jirti. Haa ta'u malee, yeroo ammaa kana rakkoon geejjibaa fi gatiin fe'umsaa idil-addunyaa dabaluun isaa qabeenya isaanii irratti dhiibbaa cimaa uumaa jira. Walitti bu'iinsa naannawa biyyoota giddu galeessa bahaa irraa kan ka'e baasii geejjibaa fi fe'umsaa dabaluun isaa, qonnaan beeytittiin gabaa Awurooppaa irratti dorgomtuu ta'ee itti fufuuf qormaata guddaa keessa galteetti.

title: The Hotel That Housed the OAU Meets the Wrecking Ball
english: Ethiopia Hotel, a historic landmark in Addis Ababa known for hosting the 1963 OAU founding, is currently being demolished to make way for a modern tower. The owner, BK Group, plans to replace the six-decade-old structure with a larger, contemporary complex. While this redevelopment marks a significant change for the city, it has also sparked concerns regarding the preservation of historical landmarks in the capital.
amharic: የአፍሪካ አንድነት ድርጅትን የመመስረቻ ስብሰባን በማስተናገድ የሚታወቀውና በአዲስ አበባ ታሪካዊ ምልክት የሆነው ኢትዮጵያ ሆቴል፣ በአዲስ ዘመናዊ ሕንፃ ለመተካት እየፈረሰ ነው። የሆቴሉ ባለቤት የሆነው ቢኬ ግሩፕ፣ ከስድስት አስርት ዓመታት በላይ አገልግሎት የሰጠውን የድሮ ሕንፃ በማፍረስ ዘመናዊ ግንባታ ለማካሄድ እቅድ አውጥቷል። ሆኖም ይህ የከተማዋን ገጽታ የሚቀይር ግንባታ፣ የታሪካዊ ቅርሶች ጥበቃን በተመለከተ በከተማዋ ነዋሪዎች ዘንድ ጥያቄዎችን አስነስቷል።
oromo: Hoteelli Itoophiyaa kan durii, kan hundeeffama gamtaa Afrikaa (OAU) bara 1963 keessummeessuun beekamu, bakka isaa gamoo ammayyaa ijaaruuf diigamaa jira. Abbaan qabeenyaa isaa, gareen BK, gamoolee waggaa ja’atamii oliif tajaajila kennan diigee bakka isaanii bakka ammayyaa ijaaruuf karoorfateera. Diigamni kun, guddina magaalaa Finfinnee keessatti jijjiirama guddaa fiduus, dhimmichi eegumsa seenaa fi bakkeewwan seena qabeeyyii irratti gaaffii uumee jira.

title: Tax on Alcohol, Tobacco Worked. Study Finds That May Be the Problem
english: Ethiopia's excise tax on alcohol and tobacco has successfully increased government revenue and reduced legal sales, but it is causing unintended consequences. Many consumers are avoiding higher prices by switching to unregulated homemade alcohol and illicit cigarettes. Researchers warn that this shift not only undermines the tax's effectiveness but also moves consumption into markets that bypass safety regulations and government oversight.
amharic: በኢትዮጵያ በአልኮል እና በሲጋራ ላይ የተጣለው የኤክሳይስ ታክስ የመንግስትን ገቢ በመጨመር ህጋዊ ሽያጮችን ለመቀነስ ቢሳካም ያልታሰበ ችግር ፈጥሯል። ብዙ ሸማቾች የዋጋ ጭማሪውን በመሸሽ ወደ ቤት ውስጥ ወደሚጠመቁ መጠጦች እና ህገ-ወጥ ሲጋራዎች እያመሩ ይገኛሉ። ተመራማሪዎች ይህ ሁኔታ የታክሱ ትርፍ እየቀነሰ መምጣቱን ብቻ ሳይሆን፣ ህገ-ወጥ የገበያ እንቅስቃሴዎች እንዲስፋፉ እና የጤና ቁጥጥር እንዲዳከም እያደረገ መሆኑን አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Gibirri alkoolii fi tamboo irratti biyya keenyatti godhame galii mootummaa dabaluu fi gurgurtaa seera qabeessa hir'isuu irratti milkaa'us, rakkoo biraa fiduu danda'eera. Maamiltoonni hedduun gatii dabale kana baqachuudhaan gara dhugaatii mana keessatti qophaa'uu fi tamboo seeraan alatti gurguramutti jijjiiramaa jiru. Qorattoonni akka ibsanitti, jijjiiramni kun bu'aa gibirichi qabu xiqqeessuu qofa osoo hin taane, gabaa seeraan alaa babal'isuu fi to'annoo fayyaa dadhabsiisuu danda'a.

title: Bus Firms Spend Hundreds of Millions, Hit Bank, Tariff, Charging Walls
english: Three major inter-city transport companies have invested 450 million Birr to upgrade their fleets to comply with new government regulations. However, these businesses now face serious financial risks due to high taxes, difficult bank lending conditions, and a lack of necessary infrastructure like charging stations. The operators argue that inconsistent government policies and the removal of previously agreed-upon incentives are threatening their massive investments.
amharic: ሶስት ዋና ዋና የከተማ አቋራጭ የትራንስፖርት ድርጅቶች የመንግስትን አዲስ መመሪያ ለማክበር 450 ሚሊዮን ብር ወጪ በማድረግ አዳዲስ አውቶቡሶችን ገዝተዋል። ይሁን እንጂ ድርጅቶቹ በከፍተኛ ታክስ፣ በብድር እጥረት እና እንደ ኃይል መሙያ ጣቢያ ባሉ መሰረተ ልማቶች አለመሟላት ምክንያት ከፍተኛ የገንዘብ ኪሳራ አደጋ ውስጥ መውደቃቸውን ገልጸዋል። በተደጋጋሚ የሚቀያየሩ የመንግስት ፖሊሲዎች እና ቀደም ሲል የነበሩ ጥቅማጥቅሞች መቅረታቸው ኢንቨስትመንታቸውን አደጋ ላይ እንደጣለባቸው ቅሬታቸውን ያቀርባሉ።
oromo: Dhaabbileen geejjiba magaalaota gidduu hojjetan sadan, qajeelfama mootummaan haaraa baase kabajuuf jecha gabaa birrii miiliyoona 450 baasanii konkolaattota haaraa bitaniiru. Haa ta'u malee, gibira ol'aanaa, hanqina liqii baankii fi hanqina bu'uuraalee misoomaa akka buufata chaarjii jiran irraa kan ka'e, dhaabbileen kun rakkoo dinagdee cimaa keessa seenaniiru. Abbootiin qabeenyaa kun, jijjiirama siyaasaa mootummaa fi haquma faayidaa duraan walii galameefiin invastimantiin isaanii balaaf saaxilamuu isaatiif komii dhiyeeffataa jiru.

title: More troops to be sent to West Bank village besieged by Israeli settlers
english: The Israeli military is deploying more soldiers to a West Bank village after failing to remove settlers who have besieged two Palestinian families for several days. These families have been trapped without power, water, or sufficient food, sparking significant international concern. U.S. officials have condemned the violence and pressured Israel to intervene as the military struggles to control settler actions in the area.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በዌስት ባንክ መንደር ለብዙ ቀናት ሁለት የፍልስጤም ቤተሰቦችን ከበው የያዙ ሰፋሪዎችን ማስወጣት ባለመቻላቸው ተጨማሪ ወታደሮችን ለመላክ ተገደዋል። ቤተሰቦቹ ያለ ኤሌክትሪክ፣ ውሃ እና ምግብ በመታሰራቸው ዓለም አቀፍ ትኩረትን ስቧል። የአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት ይህንን ጥቃት በማውገዝ እስራኤል ፈጣን እርምጃ እንድትወስድ ግፊት እያደረጉ ሲሆን፣ እስራኤልም በሰፋሪዎች ላይ ቁጥጥር ለማድረግ እየተቸገረች ትገኛለች።
oromo: Waraanni Israa'el maatiiwwan Falasxiin lama guyyoota hedduuf naannawa Qusraa keessatti marfaman gadhiisiisuu waan dadhabeef, waraana dabalataa gara naannichaatti ergaa jira. Maatiiwwan kunneen bishaan, ibsaa fi nyaata malee hidhamanii turuun isaanii yaaddoo addunyaa kaasee jira. Aangottonni Ameerikaa gocha kana balaaleeffachuun Israa'el tarkaanfii akka fudhattu gaafataniiru, mootummaan Israa'el garuu gocha raawwattoota kana to'achuuf rakkachaa jira.

title: Indian actor's video with endangered gibbon sparks investigation
english: Indian actor Vikram is facing an official investigation after posting a video on social media showing him interacting with an endangered lar gibbon. Wildlife authorities are looking into how the protected animal ended up in a private residence in Chennai and whether its possession follows legal requirements. While the actor has not yet issued a statement, officials are currently verifying if the gibbon was obtained and imported in accordance with international wildlife trade regulations.
amharic: የህንድ ተዋናይ ቪክራም አደጋ ላይ ያለ ዝርያ የሆነውን 'ላር ጊቦን' የተባለ የዝንጀሮ ዓይነት አቅፎ የሚያሳይ ቪዲዮ በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ ላይ ከለቀቀ በኋላ ምርመራ እየተካሄደበት ነው። የዱር እንስሳት ጥበቃ ባለስልጣናት እንስሳው በቼናይ በሚገኝ የግል መኖሪያ ቤት ውስጥ እንዴት እንደገባ እና አያያዙ ህጋዊ መሆኑን እያጣሩ ነው። ተዋናዩ እስካሁን በጉዳዩ ላይ ምንም አይነት መግለጫ ያልሰጠ ሲሆን ባለስልጣናት እንስሳው በአለም አቀፍ ህግ መሰረት በህጋዊ መንገድ መግባቱን ለማረጋገጥ እየሰሩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Aartistiin biyya Indiyaa Viikraam, fakkii sochiilee miidiyaa irratti bineensa gosa 'laar gibboon' jedhamu kan baduuf jedhu waliin taphachaa jiru erga gadhiisee booda qorannoon irra gaggeeffamaa jira. Qondaaltonni eegumsa bineensotaa, bineensi kun akkamitti manatti akka dhufeefi qabiinsi isaa seera qabeessa ta'uu isaa qulqulleeffachaa jiru. Aartistichi hanga ammaatti ibsa kan hin kennine yoo ta'u, qondaaltonni bineensi kun seera addunyaa kabajuun gara biyyattii galee jiraachuu isaa mirkaneeffachuuf carraaqqii gochaa jiru.

title: How to stay safe during an earthquake: A visual guide
english: To stay safe during an earthquake, it is essential to prepare your home by securing heavy furniture and creating an emergency kit with basic supplies like water, food, and medicine. When shaking occurs, remain indoors and avoid running outside to protect yourself from falling debris. After the earthquake stops, check for injuries and remain alert for potential hazards like gas leaks or aftershocks.
amharic: የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ በሚከሰትበት ጊዜ ደህንነትን ለመጠበቅ ከባድ የቤት እቃዎችን ማሰር እና እንደ ውሃ፣ ምግብ እና መድሃኒት ያሉ አስፈላጊ ቁሳቁሶችን የያዘ የአደጋ ጊዜ ቦርሳ ማዘጋጀት በጣም አስፈላጊ ነው። መንቀጥቀጡ ሲጀምር ከህንጻ ውጭ ከመሮጥ ይልቅ በቤት ውስጥ መቆየት ከሚወድቁ ነገሮች ይከላከላል። መንቀጥቀጡ ካቆመ በኋላ በሰውነትዎ ላይ ጉዳት መኖሩን ያረጋግጡ እና እንደ ጋዝ ፍሳሽ ወይም ተከታታይ መንቀጥቀጦች ያሉ አደጋዎች ስለሚኖሩ ጥንቃቄ ያድርጉ።
oromo: Gidiraa dachee yeroo raafamu of eeggannoo gochuuf, mana keessatti meeshaalee ulfaatoo hidhuu fi qophii hatattamaa kan akka bishaan, nyaata, fi qoricha walitti qabachun murteessadha. Yeroo raafamni jalqabu, ala fiigun balaa jiru waan dabaluuf, mana keessatti tasgabbaa'anii turuun irra caala. Erga raafamni dhaabatee booda, miidhaan jiraachu isaa of haa qorannu akkasumas balaa biraa kan akka xiriirri gaazii ykn raafama lammaffaa irratti xiyyeeffannoo haa kenninu.

title: Part of children’s hospital collapses in Colombia earthquake
english: A powerful 7.4 magnitude earthquake struck Cali, Colombia, on Monday, causing a section of a local children's hospital to crumble. Security footage recorded the building's partial collapse during the tremor. The disaster has resulted in at least 265 confirmed fatalities, with many other individuals currently reported as missing.
amharic: ሰኞ ዕለት በኮሎምቢያ ካሊ ከተማ በተከሰተ የ7.4 ማግኒቲዩድ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ የህፃናት ሆስፒታል ህንፃ ከፊል ክፍል ወድቋል። የደህንነት ካሜራዎች ህንፃው ሲፈርስ የተቀረጸውን ምስል ያሳዩ ሲሆን፣ እስካሁን በደረሰው አደጋ ቢያንስ 265 ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። አሁንም በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች የት እንዳሉ አልታወቀም።
oromo: Dilbata darbe biyya Kolombiyaa magaalaa Kaalii keessatti sochiin lafaa humni isaa 7.4 ta’e mudatee hospitaala daa’immanii tokkoo irratti miidhaa guddaa geessiseera. Kaameraawwan nageenyaa bakki hospitaalichaa tokko yeroo diigamu suuraa kaasaniru. Balaa kanaan lubbuun namoota 265 olii darbeera, namoonni dhibbaan lakkaa’amanis hanga ammaatti eessa akka jiran hin beekamu.

title: As temperatures soar, ‘exceptionally serious’ drought imperils UK farmers
english: Farmers in the United Kingdom are facing a severe agricultural crisis due to record-breaking heat and a lack of rainfall, which has left much of the country in a state of drought. The persistent dry conditions have caused crop yields to plummet and damaged soil health, forcing many producers to call for urgent government support. Experts warn that this recurring pattern of extreme weather is an increasingly serious threat to the nation's food production.
amharic: በዩናይትድ ኪንግደም ከፍተኛ የሙቀት መጠን እና የዝናብ እጥረት በመከሰቱ ገበሬዎች ከባድ የግብርና ቀውስ ውስጥ ገብተዋል። በሀገሪቱ በአብዛኛው አካባቢዎች የተከሰተው ድርቅ የምርት መጠን እንዲቀንስ እና የአፈር ሁኔታ እንዲበላሽ ስላደረገ፣ አምራቾች አስቸኳይ የመንግስት ድጋፍ እንዲደረግላቸው እየጠየቁ ነው። ባለሙያዎች ይህ በተደጋጋሚ የሚከሰት ከፍተኛ የአየር ንብረት ለውጥ ለሀገሪቱ የምግብ ዋስትና ከፍተኛ ስጋት እየፈጠረ መሆኑን ያስጠነቅቃሉ።
oromo: Biyyoota Gamtoomanii keessatti ho'i baay'ee fi roobni hir'achuu isaatiin walqabatee qotee bultoonni rakkoo cimaa keessa galaniiru. Hanqinni roobaa kun omisha gadi buusuu fi qulqullina biyyee irratti dhiibbaa waan geessiseef, qotee bultoonni mootummaan gargaarsa ariifachiisaa akka godhuuf gaafachaa jiru. Ogeeyyiin akka jedhanitti, haalli qilleensaa hamaa ta'e kun irra deddeebi'ee mudachuun isaa nageenya nyaataa biyyattii irratti balaa guddaa agarsiisa.

title: Three US states to hold executions on same day for first time since 2010
english: For the first time since 2010, three U.S. states—Tennessee, Alabama, and Oklahoma—are scheduled to carry out executions on the same day. Each inmate involved was convicted of murder, and these events occur despite a long-term national decline in public support for capital punishment. This rare triple execution highlights ongoing debates regarding the death penalty in the United States.
amharic: ከ2010 ወዲህ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ ሶስት የአሜሪካ ግዛቶች ማለትም ቴነሲ፣ አላባማ እና ኦክላሆማ በአንድ ቀን ውስጥ የሞት ፍርድ ለመፈጸም ተዘጋጅተዋል። በነዚህ ግዛቶች የሚፈጸሙት ግድያዎች ከባድ የወንጀል ድርጊት ፈጽመዋል በተባሉ እስረኞች ላይ የሚካሄዱ ናቸው። ምንም እንኳን በአሜሪካ የሞት ቅጣትን የሚደግፉ ሰዎች ቁጥር እየቀነሰ ቢመጣም፣ ይህ ክስተት በሀገሪቱ የሞት ቅጣት አሰጣጥ ላይ ትኩረትን ስቧል።
oromo: Akkuma bara 2010 booda yeroo jalqabaatiif, mootummoonni naannoo Ameerikaa sadan—Tennessee, Alabama fi Oklahoma—guyyaa tokkotti namoota adabbii du'aa itti murtaa'e ajjeesuuf qophaa'aniiru. Namoonni ajjeefaman kunneen hundi yakka ajjeechaa raawwachuun kan itti murtaa'aniidha. Ta'us, Ameerikaa keessatti namoonni adabbii du'aa morman dabalaa dhufuun beekamus, raawwiin kun seera adabbii du'aa irratti marii kaaseera.

title: Swiatek sinks Svitolina to set up Rybakina title clash in Toronto
english: Iga Swiatek defeated Elina Svitolina in the Toronto semifinals to secure a spot in the final. She will compete for the championship title against Elena Rybakina, who advanced after a comeback victory over Coco Gauff. This match marks Swiatek's first final appearance of the year as both players prepare for the upcoming US Open.
amharic: ኢጋ ስዋይቴክ በቶሮንቶ የግማሽ ፍጻሜ ጨዋታ ኤሊና ስቪቶሊናን በማሸነፍ ለፍጻሜ ደርሳለች። ለዋንጫው የምትፋለመው ደግሞ ኮኮ ጋፍን በመርታት ለፍጻሜ የደረሰችውን ኤሌና ሪባኪናን ነው። ይህ ውድድር ሁለቱም ተጫዋቾች ለሚመጣው የዩኤስ ኦፕን ውድድር እየተዘጋጁ ባለበት ወቅት፣ ስዋይቴክ በዚህ ዓመት ለፍጻሜ ስታልፍ የመጀመሪያዋ ነው።
oromo: Iga Swiatek tapha semi-fainalii Tooroontoo irratti Elina Svitolina mo'achuun gara fainaliitti darbiteetti. Igaan qophii tapha xumuraa irratti kan qunnamtu taphataan biyya Kaazaakistaan Elena Rybakina yoo taatu, isheenis Coco Gauff injifachuun xumuraaf ga'eetti. Taphoonni kun qophii dorgommii US Open irratti ta'uuf, Igaaf bara kanaaf yeroo jalqabaaf gara tapha xumuraa kan ishee geessise dha.

title: Iran says Strait of Hormuz is under its control
english: A senior Iranian official claims that Iran holds authority over the Strait of Hormuz. This statement serves as a direct rebuttal to US President Donald Trump, who recently asserted that America maintains full control of the vital shipping route. The conflicting declarations highlight ongoing geopolitical tensions regarding the management of this strategic waterway.
amharic: የኢራን ከፍተኛ ባለሥልጣን የሆርሙዝ የባሕር መተላለፊያ በኢራን ቁጥጥር ሥር መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። ይህ መግለጫ አሜሪካ በዚሁ የባሕር መስመር ላይ ሙሉ ቁጥጥር እንዳላት የገለጹትን የአሜሪካውን ፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ንግግር የሚቃረን ነው። የሁለቱ ወገኖች ተቃራኒ አቋም በዚህ ስልታዊ የባሕር መስመር አስተዳደር ዙሪያ ያለውን ውጥረት ያሳያል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Iran akka jedhanitti, daandiin galaana Hormuz gama isaanitiin to’atamaa jira. Ibsi kun kan kenname, pirezidaantiin Amerika Donald Trump daandii galaana kanaa guutumaan guutuutti to’ataa akka jiran dubbachuu isaanii hordofee dha. Wal dhabdee ibsa kanaanis, nageenya daandii galaana kanaa irratti wal dhabdee siyaasaa jiru agarsiisa.

title: British maritime company engaged in salvage of stricken vessel off Omani coast
english: A British maritime security firm named Ambrey is currently managing the rescue of a tanker called Caroline Bezengi near the coast of Oman. Additional salvage ships have been dispatched to assist with the recovery efforts. The situation is being actively monitored to ensure the vessel is safely secured.

Hojii kana deggaruuf dooniiwwan gargaarsa biroo gara iddoo sanatti ergamaniiru. Hojiin doonii kana fayyisuuf taasifamu xiyyeeffannoon itti fufuun isaa ibsameera.

oromo: Mootummaan Yaman humnoota Huutii waliin walii galtee uumuu diduun, nagaa waaraa kan biyyattii irratti humna waraanaa tokko qofa taasisu barbaaduu isaa ibseera. title: Pakistan says Israel's refusal to withdraw forces from Gaza 'serious setback' to peace plan
english: Pakistan has formally criticized Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu for rejecting the creation of a Palestinian state and refusing to pull troops out of Gaza. The Pakistani Foreign Ministry emphasized that Palestinian statehood is supported by international law and UN mandates, regardless of Israel's current stance. Officials in Islamabad warned that Israel’s decision to maintain a military presence in Gaza undermines previously agreed-upon peace commitments.

oromo: Paakistaan ministira muummee Israa'el Binyamiin Neetaanyaahuu mootummaa Falasxiin uumuuf diduu fi waraana ishee gaazaatii baasuu diduu ishee cimsitee balaaleffatteetti. Bulchiinsi Islaamaabaad akka ibsetti, Israa'el gaazaa keessaa waraana ishee baasuu diduun ishee walii galtee nagaa duraan irra ga'ame kan cabsuu fi carraaqqii nagaa irratti gufuu guddaa akka ta'e akeekkachiisteetti.

title: Israeli troops set on fire, bombed homes in south Lebanon
english: Early on Thursday, Israeli military forces conducted bombings and burned residential houses in southern Lebanese towns, including Majdal Zoun and Mansouri. These military actions have persisted even as discussions regarding a potential peace deal remain ongoing. The attacks continue to impact civilian infrastructure in the region despite international efforts to reach a ceasefire.

oromo: Guyyaa Kamisaa ganama, waraanni Israa'el magaalonni kibba Libaanoos kanneen akka Majdal Zoon fi Mansuurii keessatti haleellaa boombii gaggeessuun manneen jiraattotaa gubaniiru. Haasaawwan nagaa ta’aa jiranis, waraanni Israa'el haleellaa isaa itti fufuu isaa gabaasni ni mul'isa. Haleellaan kun qabeenyaa fi jireenya nagaa naannichaa irratti miidhaa guddaa geessisuu isaa itti fufeera.

title: The US is now using the ‘terrorist’ label to interfere in Brazil’s election
english: The United States recently labeled Brazil's two largest criminal groups, the PCC and CV, as terrorist organizations. Critics argue this move is politically motivated rather than based on security needs, as these groups primarily seek criminal profit rather than political change. By applying this label, the US is accused of interfering in Brazilian internal politics and empowering the country’s far-right factions.

title: Will the Houthis shut down Saudi Arabian shipping?
english: There are growing international concerns regarding the potential for renewed conflict in Yemen, which could threaten maritime security in the region. Analysts are questioning whether Houthi forces might attempt to disrupt Saudi Arabian shipping lanes as regional tensions escalate. This situation highlights the ongoing instability in the Middle East and the complex security challenges facing major global trade routes.
