Walitti bu'iinsi naannichaa hammaachaa waan jiruuf, gareen Huutii karaa dooniiwwan Sa'udii Arabaa ittiin darban cufuuf yaaluu danda'a jedhanii ogeeyyiin gaaffii kaasuutti jiru. Haalli kun nageenya dhabuu Baha Giddu-galeessaa fi balaa karaaleen daldala addunyaa qaban kan mul'isu dha.

title: Polls open in Zambia presidential election as economic reforms tested
english: Zambians are heading to the polls to decide if President Hakainde Hichilema deserves a second term as the country deals with significant economic struggles. While the current administration highlights its recent reforms and infrastructure projects, many voters remain concerned about the high cost of living. The election features 13 candidates, with former minister Brian Mundubile emerging as the main opposition figure challenging Hichilema’s leadership.

Mootummaan ammaa hojii misoomaa fi jijjiirama dinagdee hojjechaa jiraachuu ibsus, lammiileen baay'een gatiin jireenyaa olka'uu isaan yaaddessee jira. Filannoo kana irratti dorgomtoonni 13 kan hirmaatan yoo ta'u, ministeerri duraanii Biraayin Mundubilee mormituu ijoo ta'uun prezedanticha quunnameera.

title: Nearly 4 million Afghan children ‘acutely malnourished’
english: A new report from Save the Children reveals that nearly 4 million Afghan children under five are suffering from acute malnutrition. This crisis is worsening because humanitarian funding has dropped significantly, leading to the closure of hundreds of essential health clinics. As aid continues to decline, children are losing access to the life-saving support they need to survive.

Deeggarsi maallaqaa yeroo ammaa xiqqachaa waan deemeef, ijoolleen tajaajila fayyaa lubbuu isaanii baraaruu danda'u argachuu irratti rakkoo guddaa keessa jiru.

title: Putin can no longer claim victory in Ukraine, Nobel Peace Prize winner tells BBC
english: Nobel Peace Prize laureate Dmitry Muratov stated that Vladimir Putin has lost the ability to achieve victory in the Ukraine conflict. Muratov highlighted that Russia has intensified its crackdown on free speech, resulting in the silencing of independent outlets like his newspaper, Novaya Gazeta. He further warned that thousands of citizens are being imprisoned for opposing state policies, reflecting a level of suppression that exceeds the intensity seen during the Soviet era.
amharic: የኖቤል የሰላም ሽልማት አሸናፊው ዲሚትሪ ሙራቶቭ፣ ቭላድሚር ፑቲን በዩክሬን ጦርነት ድል የመቀዳጀት ዕድል እንደሌላቸው ተናግረዋል። ሙራቶቭ እንደገለጹት፣ በሩሲያ ውስጥ የመናገር ነፃነት ላይ እየተደረገ ያለው ጫና ተባብሶ የእሳቸው ጋዜጣ የሆነችውን ኖቫያ ጋዜታን ጨምሮ በርካታ ነፃ ሚዲያዎች እንዲዘጉ ተደርጓል። በሀገሪቱ የሰላማዊ ፖሊሲን በመቃወማቸው ብቻ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ዜጎች መታሰራቸውን የገለጹት ሙራቶቭ፣ ይህ የጭቆና መጠን የቀድሞው የሶቪየት ዘመንን የባሰ መሆኑን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Badhaasa Nobeliin kan badhaafaman Dimitrii Muraatov, Putiin waraana Yukreen keessatti injifannoo argachuu akka hin dandeenye ibsaniiru. Muraatov akka jedhanitti, Raashiyaan mirga yaada ibsachuu irratti ukkaamsaa cimaa gochuun, gaazexaan isaanii 'Novaayaa Gaazeetaa' dabalatee miidiyaaleen walaba ta'an akka cufaman ta'eera. Namoonni kumaan lakkaa'aman siyaasa mootummaa mormuu isaaniitiin hidhamuu isaanii kan eeran Muraatov, ukkaamsaan kun yeroo Sooviyeet durii caalaa kan hamaate ta'uu akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: Russian strike sparks fire at Ukraine port; Zelenskyy seeks interceptors
english: Russian forces recently attacked a key grain port in Izmail, leading to a significant fire and infrastructure damage. Amidst these intensified strikes, President Zelenskyy is urgently requesting that the United States provide a small percentage of its Patriot missile supply to bolster Ukraine's failing defense systems. Ukraine is currently struggling to intercept rapid ballistic missiles and warns that these shortages will endanger many lives throughout the winter.
amharic: የሩሲያ ኃይሎች በቅርቡ በኢዝማይል ወደብ ላይ ባደረሱት ጥቃት ከፍተኛ የእሳት ቃጠሎና የንብረት ውድመት አስከትለዋል። በዚህ የጥቃት ውጥረት ውስጥ፣ ፕሬዝዳንት ዘለንስኪዩዩ ዩክሬን እያጋጠማት ያለውን የአየር መከላከያ ክፍተት ለመሙላት አሜሪካ ከሚገኘው የፓትሪዮት ሚሳይል ክምችት ጥቂት በመቶ እንድትሸጥላቸው በአስቸኳይ እየጠየቁ ነው። ዩክሬን ፈጣን የባላስቲክ ሚሳይሎችን መከላከል ተስኗት በመቆየቷ፣ ይህ የአቅርቦት እጥረት በክረምቱ ወቅት የብዙ ሰዎችን ህይወት አደጋ ላይ እንደሚጥል ተገልጿል።
oromo: Humnoonni Raashiyaa dhiheenya kana buufata doonii Izmaayil irratti haleellaa raawwataniin ibidda guddaa fi miidhaa qabeenyaa geessiseera. Haleellaa kana hordofee, Pireezidaanti Zelenskii guutuu biyyattii keessatti meeshaalee ittisa xiyyaaraa (Patriot) dhabamuurraa kan ka'e, Ameerikaan qabeenya ishee keessaa harka xinnoo akka isaan gurgurtu hatattamaan gaafataniiru. Yeroo ammaa Yukreen xiyyaara waraanaa saffisaa (ballistic missiles) ittisuu waan dadhabdeef, hanqinni kun gannaa dhufu kana lubbuu namoota hedduu balaaf saaxiluu danda'a jedhamee sodaatama.

title: Why tariffs are not the right tool to bolster US production
english: Donald Trump is heavily relying on tariffs to try and strengthen the United States economy and increase domestic production. However, many economists are skeptical about this approach and doubt that these trade barriers will achieve the intended results. Despite his focus on this strategy, experts suggest that tariffs may not be the most effective way to improve the country's manufacturing output.
amharic: ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የዩናይትድ ስቴትስን ኢኮኖሚ ለማጠናከር እና የአገር ውስጥ ምርትን ለመጨመር በታሪፍ ወይም በንግድ ቀረጥ ላይ በእጅጉ ይተማመናሉ። ሆኖም፣ ብዙ ኢኮኖሚስቶች ይህ ስልት ውጤታማ እንደሆነ ጥርጣሬ አላቸው። በታሪፍ አማካኝነት የሚደረገው ግፊት አገሪቱ የምትፈልገውን የኢንዱስትሪ ዕድገት ለማምጣት ትክክለኛው መፍትሔ ላይሆን እንደሚችል ባለሙያዎች ይናገራሉ።
oromo: Donald Trump dinagdee Yuunaytid Isteetis cimsuufi oomisha biyya keessaa dabaluuf gibira gurguddaa (tariffs) fayyadamaa jira. Haa ta'u malee, ogeeyyiin diinagdee hedduun tarsiimoon kun bu'aa gaarii akka hin qabneefi kaayyoo barbaadame akka hin galmaannee shakkii qabu. Gibirri gurguddaa kun oomishummaa biyyattii fooyyessuuf mala sirrii ta'uu akka hin dandeenye hayyoonni ni ibsu.

title: Leavitt to leave as White House press secretary
english: Karoline Leavitt, the youngest person to serve as White House press secretary, has declared she will resign from her post by the end of this month. She stated that her decision to leave the role is motivated by a desire to prioritize her family. Her departure marks the end of her notable tenure in this high-profile position.
amharic: የዋይት ሀውስ የፕሬስ ጸሐፊ በመሆን ያገለገለችው ካሮሊን ሊቪት ከወሩ መጨረሻ ጀምሮ ከኃላፊነቷ እንደምትለቅ አስታውቃለች። ሊቪት የዋይት ሀውስ የፕሬስ ጸሐፊ በመሆን ያገለገለች በጣም ወጣቷ ግለሰብ ነች። ከሥራዋ የምትለቀውም ጊዜዋን ለቤተሰቧ ለመስጠት እንደሆነ ገልጻለች።
oromo: Hoggantuun dubbi himtuu waajjira mana mootummaa (White House) kan taate Karoliin Liiviit, dhuma ji’a kanaa irratti hojii ishee gadhiisuuf murteessiteetti. Liiviit dubbi himtuu mana mootummaa taatee kan hojjette umuriin ishee xiqqa ta’uun kan beekamtudha. Murtoon hojii gadhiisuu ishee kunis maatii isheetiif xiyyeeffannaa kennuuf akka ta’e ibsiteetti.

title: Three Palestinian families besieged in their homes by Israeli settlers
english: Three Palestinian families in the West Bank village of Qusra are currently trapped in their homes due to a blockade by Israeli settlers. The settlers have cut off essential services including water and electricity while preventing the families from leaving. Although the Israeli military recently cleared a nearby outpost, the settlers quickly returned to continue the siege.
amharic: በዌስት ባንክ ኩስራ መንደር የሚገኙ ሦስት የፍልስጤም ቤተሰቦች በእስራኤል ሰፈራተኞች ታግተው ይገኛሉ። ሰፈራተኞቹ ቤተሰቦቹ ከቤታቸው እንዳይወጡ ከመከልከላቸውም በላይ የውሃ እና የኤሌክትሪክ አገልግሎቶችን አቋርጠውባቸዋል። የእስራኤል ጦር በአካባቢው የነበረውን ህገ-ወጥ ሰፈር ቢያፈርስም፣ ሰፈራተኞቹ ወዲያውኑ በመመለስ ጥቃቱን ቀጥለዋል።
oromo: Maatiin Palastaayinii sadii baadiyyaa Qusraa kan West Bank keessatti argaman, uummata Israa'el biyya sana irraa buqqa'anii dhufaniin manneen isaanii keessatti ugguramanii jiru. Namoonni kunneen bishaanifi humna ibsaa irraa kutuun maatiin kun akka hin baane godhaniiru. Waraanni Israa'el buufata isaanitti dhihoo jiru tokko yoo diiges, namoonni kunneen yeroodhuma sana deebi'uun marfannaa isaanii itti fufaniiru.

title: Search efforts in Colombia enter ‘final phase’ as quake toll reaches 265
english: Rescue teams in Colombia are moving into the final stage of search operations following a powerful 7.4 magnitude earthquake that has claimed at least 265 lives. With nearly 500 people still missing, crews are working urgently as the critical 72-hour survival window closes. President de La Espriella has declared an economic emergency and pledged to create a recovery fund to rebuild vital infrastructure like schools and hospitals.
amharic: በኮሎምቢያ የተከሰተውን የ7.4 ማግኒቲዩድ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ ተከትሎ የነፍስ አድን ስራዎች ወደ መጨረሻ ምዕራፍ ተሸጋግረዋል። እስካሁን ባለው መረጃ መሰረት 265 ሰዎች ህይወታቸው ያለፈ ሲሆን፣ ወደ 500 የሚጠጉ ሰዎች ደግሞ የደረሱበት አልታወቀም። ፕሬዝዳንት ደ ላ ኤስፕሪዬላ የድንገተኛ ጊዜ አዋጅ በማወጅ የወደሙ ትምህርት ቤቶችን እና ሆስፒታሎችን እንደገና ለመገንባት የሚያስችል ፈንድ እንደሚመሰርቱ ቃል ገብተዋል።
oromo: Kolombiyaa keessatti kirkirri lafaa cimaan 7.4 ga’u erga mudatee booda, hojiin barbaacha fi furmaata fayyaa gara sadarkaa xumuraatti ce’eera. Hanga ammaa namootni 265 lubbuun isaanii yoo darbu, namootni 500 ol ta’an immoo eessa akka jiran hin beekamu. Pirezidaantiin biyyattii hatattamaan labsiin diinagdee akka labsamu gochuun, manneen barnootaa fi hospitaala diigaman deebisanii ijaaruuf gargaarsa akka godhan waadaa galaniiru.

title: Israeli settlers besiege Palestinian families in West Bank’s Qusra
english: Israeli settlers have surrounded three Palestinian families in the West Bank village of Qusra, cutting off their access to electricity, water, and essential supplies. The affected residents are refusing to leave their homes, fearing that abandoning their property will allow the settlers to seize their land permanently. Although military forces have been present in the area, the families report that they have not received sufficient protection, leaving them in a desperate situation as their resources dwindle.
amharic: በዌስት ባንክ ኩስራ መንደር የሚገኙ የኢስራኤል ሰፈራ ሰሪዎች ሦስት የፍልስጤም ቤተሰቦችን በመክበብ የኤሌክትሪክ፣ የውኃ እና የምግብ አቅርቦታቸውን ቆርጠዋል። ቤተሰቦቹ ቤታቸውን ለቀው ቢወጡ መሬታቸው በሰፈራ ሰሪዎቹ እንደሚወሰድ በመስጋት በጽናት ቤት ውስጥ ተቀምጠዋል። የኢስራኤል ወታደሮች በአካባቢው ቢኖሩም ለተጎጂዎቹ አስፈላጊውን ጥበቃ አላደረጉም ሲሉ ነዋሪዎቹ ቅሬታቸውን ገልጸዋል፤ በዚህም ምክንያት ቤተሰቦቹ በከፍተኛ ችግር ውስጥ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Buqqaattoonni Israa'el ganda Qusraa kan West Bank keessatti argamu keessatti maatiiwwan Falasxiin sadii marsuun bishaan, ibsaa fi meeshaalee barbaachisoo ta'an irraa addaan kutaniiru. Maatiiwwan kun lafti isaanii akka hin fudhatamneef manaa isaanii gadhiisuuf kan hin fedhine yoo ta'u, jireenya rakkisaa keessatti argamu. Humnoonni waraanaa Israa'el naannichatti argamanis gargaarsa gahaa akka hin taasiisneefi isaan dhiisanii akka jiran maatiiwwan kun himaniiru.

title: Solar eclipse carves Eiffel Tower’s silhouette in Paris sky
english: A partial solar eclipse was visible over Paris, creating a striking scene as it appeared behind the Eiffel Tower. While the event was only partially visible in France and other European regions, it appeared as a total eclipse in parts of Iceland, Greenland, and Spain. This rare astronomical display drew attention across the continent.
amharic: በፓሪስ ሰማይ ላይ ከፊል የፀሐይ ግርዶሽ የታየ ሲሆን፣ ክስተቱም ታዋቂው የኢፍል ታወር ጀርባ ላይ አስደናቂ ትዕይንት ፈጥሮ ነበር። ይህ ግርዶሽ በፈረንሳይ እና በአውሮፓ ክፍሎች ከፊል ሆኖ ሲታይ፣ በግሪንላንድ፣ በአይስላንድ እና በስፔን ግን ሙሉ የፀሐይ ግርዶሽ ሆኖ ታይቷል። ያልተለመደው ይህ የሰማይ ክስተት የአህጉሪቱን ትኩረት ስቧል።
oromo: Guyyaa kaleessa magaalaa Paariis keessatti aduun hir'attee mul'achuun ishee, ijaarsa 'Eiffel Tower' duubatti haala ajaa'ibsiisaa ta'een akka mul'attu taasiseera. Guyyaan aduu kun Faransaayii fi biyyoota Awurooppaa kaan keessatti hir'atee kan mul'ate yoo ta'u, biyyoota akka Ayislaandi, Giriinlaandii fi Ispeen keessatti garuu guututti aduun akka haguugamtu ta'eera. Kunuu taatee samii adda ta'e kan namoonni hedduun itti gammadan ture.

title: Ebola outbreak on track to be deadliest ever, WHO chief says
english: The WHO director-general has warned that the current Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo could become the deadliest in history, potentially surpassing the 2014-2016 crisis. Since its official recognition in May, the rare Bundibugyo strain has spread rapidly because it was initially misdiagnosed and is complicated by regional instability. Researchers are currently working on developing and testing new vaccines to address this specific strain, as there are currently no approved treatments available.
amharic: የዓለም ጤና ድርጅት ዋና ዳይሬክተር በኮንጎ ዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ እየተከሰተ ያለው የኢቦላ ወረርሽኝ እ.ኤ.አ ከ2014-2016 ከነበረው የከፋ እና በታሪክ ገዳዩ ሊሆን እንደሚችል አስጠንቅቀዋል። በግንቦት ወር በይፋ የታወጀው ይህ ያልተለመደ የኢቦላ ዝርያ በመጀመሪያ እንደ ወባ ወይም ታይፎይድ በመሳሳቱ እና በአካባቢው ባለ የጸጥታ ችግር ምክንያት በፍጥነት ተስፋፍቷል። በአሁኑ ወቅት ሳይንቲስቶች ይህንን የኢቦላ ዝርያ ለመከላከል የሚረዱ ክትባቶችን በማዘጋጀት ላይ ሲሆኑ፣ እስካሁን ድረስ ለዚህ ዝርያ የተረጋገጠ የሕክምና አማራጭ የለም።
oromo: Hogganaan Dhaabbata Fayyaa Addunyaa (WHO) dhibee Ebola amma RD Kongo keessatti hammaachaa jiru kun, kan waggaa 2014-2016 caalaa kan lubbuu namaa baay'ee galaafatu ta'uu akka danda'u akeekkachiiseera. Dhibeen kun jalqaba irratti akka busaa ykn dhukkuba garaatti waan shakkameef ariitiidhaan babal'achuu danda'eera, akkasumas naannichatti rakkoon tasgabbii dhabuu to'annoo isaa irratti gufuu ta'eera. Ammaaf dhukkubicha kana ittisuuf tallaalliin adda addaa qorannoo irratti kan argaman yoo ta'u, hanga ammaatti garuu qorichi dhibee kanaaf mirkanaa'e hin jiru.

title: Three men will be executed on the same day as death penalties rise in US
english: For the first time in 16 years, three prisoners are set to be executed in the United States on the same day. This event reflects a broader trend of increasing capital punishment across the country following President Trump's recent executive actions to reinstate and expedite federal executions. While support for the death penalty varies among the public, the current administration is actively facilitating state and federal efforts to carry out these sentences more frequently.

oromo: Ameerikaatti waggaa 16 keessatti yeroo jalqabaatiif hidhamtoonni sadan guyyaa tokkotti akka ajjeefaman murtaa'eera. Kunis tarkaanfii Preezidaant Traamp adaba du'aa deebisanii hojiirra oolchuufi saffisiisuuf fudhatan booda, adabni du'aa biyyattii keessatti dabalaa akka jiru argisiisa. Yaanni uummataa gara garuu ta'us, mootummaan amma jiru mootummoota naannoofi federaalaa keessatti adaba kana raawwachuuf gargaarsa taasisaa jira.

title: Olympic skateboarder times epic stunt with solar eclipse
english: Spanish Olympic skateboarder Danny León successfully executed a unique skateboarding trick at the exact moment of a solar eclipse. He recorded the impressive maneuver and posted it on social media, describing it as the greatest stunt of his career. This rare synchronization of athletic skill and a celestial event has captured significant attention.
amharic: ስፓኒሽ ኦሊምፒክ የስኬትቦርድ ተጫዋች ዳኒ ሊዮን የፀሐይ ግርዶሽ በተከሰተበት ወቅት አስደናቂ የሆነ የስኬትቦርድ ትርኢት አሳይቷል። አትሌቱ ይህን ድንቅ እንቅስቃሴውን በመቅረጽ በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ ያጋራ ሲሆን፣ ይኸውም የህይወቱ ምርጥ ስራ እንደሆነ ገልጿል። ይህ ያልተለመደ የክህሎት እና የተፈጥሮ ክስተት ጥምረት በብዙዎች ዘንድ አድናቆትን አትርፏል።
oromo: Atileetiin iskeetbordii Oolompiikii kan Ispeen, Daanii Le'oon, yeroo aduun haguugamte (solar eclipse) sanatti gochaa dinqisiisaa tokko raawwateera. Le'oon tarkaanfii isaa kana viidiyoon qabatee miidiyaa hawaasaa irratti kan gadhiise yoo ta'u, gocha kana jireenya isaatii keessatti kan isa boonsuufi adda ta'e akka ta'e dubbateera. Gochi atileetichaa kun ogummaa isaa fi mudannoo uumamaa kana walitti fiduun isaa xiyyeeffannoo hedduu harkiseera.

title: Zimbabwe’s land reform enters a new chapter
english: The Zimbabwean government has initiated a new land policy that addresses long-standing disputes following the controversial land reforms that began in 2000. Under this plan, the state will return specific properties to foreign investors, correct previous errors by restoring land to Black Zimbabwean owners, and allow some white farmers to purchase their land through a compensation-linked process. Officials emphasize that this move is intended to resolve outstanding legal and investment obligations rather than reversing the original land redistribution goals.
amharic: የዚምባቡዌ መንግስት ከ2000 ዓ.ም በኋላ በተካሄደው አከራካሪ የመሬት ማሻሻያ ዙሪያ የቆዩ ክርክሮችን ለመፍታት አዲስ የመሬት ፖሊሲ ተግባራዊ ማድረግ ጀምሯል። በዚህ እቅድ መሰረት መንግስት የተወሰኑ መሬቶችን ለውጭ ባለሀብቶች የሚመልስ ሲሆን፣ በስህተት የተወሰዱ መሬቶችን ለባለቤቶቹ በመመለስ እና አንዳንድ ነጭ አርሶ አደሮች የመሬት ይዞታቸውን በካሳ ስርዓት እንዲገዙ በመፍቀድ ጉዳዮችን እያስተካከለ ነው። የሀገሪቱ ባለስልጣናት ይህ እርምጃ የቀድሞውን የመሬት ክፍፍል ግብ የሚቀለብስ ሳይሆን፣ ህጋዊ እና የኢንቨስትመንት ግዴታዎችን ለመወጣት ያለመ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Zimbaabuwee jijjiirama lafaa bara 2000 eegalee kaasee ture irratti wal-dhabdee jiru furuuf imaammata lafaa haaraa hojiirra oolchaa jira. Karoora kanaan, mootummaan lafa qabeenya biyyoota alaa ta'e deebisuu, dogoggora kanaan dura ture sirreessuun lafa abbootii qabeenyaa gurraachotaaf deebisuu, akkasumas qonnaan bultoota adii tokko tokkoof lafa isaanii kafaltii kaffaluun akka bitatan hayyamuuf ka'eera. Hojjettoonni mootummaa akka jedhanitti, tarkaanfiin kun qoodinsa lafaa duraanii kan diigu utuu hin taane, dirqama seeraa fi invastimantii mootummaan qabu xumuruuf kan yaadamedha.

title: Half a tonne of Erling Haaland branded cocaine seized in Ecuador
english: Ecuadorian police discovered nearly 500 kilograms of cocaine hidden inside a truck near the Colombian border. The drug bricks were uniquely marked with the name and photograph of professional footballer Erling Haaland. Authorities arrested a Colombian woman in connection with the significant drug seizure.
amharic: የኢኳዶር ፖሊስ ከኮሎምቢያ ድንበር አቅራቢያ በጭነት መኪና ውስጥ ተደብቆ የተገኘ ወደ 500 ኪሎ ግራም የሚጠጋ ኮኬይን መያዙን አስታውቋል። በአደንዛዥ እጾቹ ላይ የእግር ኳስ ተጫዋቹ ኤርሊንግ ሃላንድ ስም እና ምስል ታትሞባቸው ተገኝቷል። ከዚህ ግኝት ጋር በተያያዘ የኮሎምቢያዊት ሴት በቁጥጥር ስር ውላለች።
oromo: Poolisiin Ekwadoor daangaa Kolombiyaa biratti konkolaataachaa keessa dhokfamee argame kookayinii kiiloogiraama 500 ga'u qabate. Kookayinii kana irratti maqaan fi suuraan taphataa kubbaa miilaa Erling Haalaand maxxanfamee argameera. Poolisiin dhimma kana irratti dubartii lammii Kolombiyaa taate tokko to'annoo jala oolcheera.

title: Iran war live: US, Tehran exchange opposing claims over Hormuz control
english: Tensions between the United States and Iran have intensified over the strategic Strait of Hormuz. President Trump claims that the U.S. maintains complete control of the waterway, while Iranian officials remain defiant, insisting that the passage will stay closed until their specific demands are addressed. Meanwhile, shipping activity in the area has reached its lowest point in a week due to the ongoing conflict.
amharic: በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል ያለው ውጥረት በስትራቴጂካዊው የሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤ ምክንያት እየተባባሰ ነው። ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ አሜሪካ በባህረ ሰላጤው ላይ ሙሉ ቁጥጥር እንዳላት ቢገልጹም፣ የኢራን ባለስልጣናት ግን ጥያቄዎቻቸው እስኪሟሉ ድረስ መተላለፊያው ተዘግቶ እንደሚቆይ በማስጠንቀቅ አቋማቸው ላይ ጸንተዋል። በግጭቱ ምክንያት በቦታው ያለው የንግድ መርከቦች እንቅስቃሴ በአንድ ሳምንት ውስጥ ዝቅተኛው ደረጃ ላይ ደርሷል።
oromo: Waliigalteen Ameerikaafi Iraan gidduu jiru hammaachuu isaa hordofee, to'annoo daandii galaana Hormuz irratti wal-dhabiirri uumamee jira. Preezidaant Traamp Ameerikaan guutummaatti daandii kana to'achaa akka jirtu kan himan yoo ta'u, Iraan gamasheen garuu hanga gaaffiin isaanii deebii argatutti daandichi cufaa akka ta'u dhaadattee jirti. Waraana kana irraa kan ka'e, sochiin dooniiwwan daldalaa naannichatti torban tokko keessa gara sadarkaa isa gadi aanaatti gadi bu'ee jira.

title: Vultures are disappearing in Nigeria - but the 'Vulture King' is fighting to reverse the trend
english: Vulture populations across West Africa are plummeting due to hunting and traditional beliefs, putting ecosystems at risk of disease. In the Nigerian town of Awka-Etiti, a man known as the Vulture King is working to protect these birds by leveraging local spiritual traditions. Because residents view vultures as sacred messengers that signify the acceptance of religious sacrifices, the birds are safe from harm within the community's protected forest.
amharic: በምዕራብ አፍሪካ የሚገኙ የጥንብ አንሳ ዝርያዎች በአደን እና በተለያዩ እምነቶች ምክንያት ከመጥፋት አፋፍ ላይ ደርሰዋል፣ ይህም የተፈጥሮ ስነ-ምህዳርን ለአደጋ እየዳረገ ነው። በናይጄሪያ አውካ-ኢቲቲ ከተማ የሚኖሩ 'የጥንብ አንሳ ንጉስ' በመባል የሚታወቁ ሰው፣ የአካባቢውን ባህላዊ እምነት በመጠቀም እነዚህን ወፎች ለመታደግ እየሰሩ ይገኛሉ። በአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች ዘንድ ጥንብ አንሳዎች የተቀደሱ እና የመሥዋዕት ተቀባይነትን የሚያሳዩ እንደሆኑ ስለሚታመን፣ በከተማዋ ጥብቅ ደን ውስጥ በሰላም እንዲኖሩ ተደርጓል።
oromo: Afrikaa Lixaatti, adamoo fi amantiiwwan aadaa irraa kan ka'e baay'inni allaattiiwwan 'vulture' jedhamanii waamaman daran gadi bu'aa jiraachuun isaa naannoo keenya dhukkubaaf saaxilaa jira. Magaalaan Naayijeeriyaa Awka-Etiti jedhamtu keessatti, namni 'Mootii Vulture' jedhamu tokko aadaa fi amantii naannichaa fayyadamuun allaattiiwwan kunneen akka hin banne ittisaa jira. Jiraattonni naannichaa allaattiiwwan kunniin hafuuraa fi fudhatama aarsaa kan agarsiisan jedhanii waan amannaniif, bosona qulqulluu magaallattii keessatti nageenyi isaanii eegameera.

title: Trump administration arrests Southern Poverty Law Center expert for fraud
english: Federal authorities have arrested Heidi Beirich, a former top official at the Southern Poverty Law Center, on charges of wire fraud and money laundering. The Trump administration alleges that she misused donor contributions to pay off leaders of extremist groups instead of fighting them as promised. Beirich and her legal team maintain that the accusations are false and politically motivated, arguing that the investigation targets the nonprofit for its work against right-wing organizations.
amharic: የፌዴራል ባለስልጣናት የደቡባዊ ድህነት ህግ ማእከል (SPLC) የቀድሞ ከፍተኛ ባለስልጣን የሆኑትን ሃይዲ ቤይሪች በገንዘብ ማጭበርበር እና በህገ-ወጥ የገንዘብ ዝውውር ክስ በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል። የትራምፕ አስተዳደር ተከሳሡ ለጋሾችን በማታለል የተሰበሰበውን ገንዘብ ጽንፈኛ ቡድኖችን ለመዋጋት ከመጠቀም ይልቅ ለቡድኖቹ መሪዎች በምስጢር ክፍያ መፈጸማቸውን ይገልጻል። የቤይሪች ጠበቆች ግን ክሱ መሰረተ ቢስ እና በፖለቲካዊ አላማ የተፈጠረ ነው በማለት የድርጅቱን ስራ ለማዳከም የሚደረግ ዘመቻ እንደሆነ ይከራከራሉ።
oromo: Hoggantoota federaalaa kan ta'an Heidi Beirich, kan duraan dhaabbata Southern Poverty Law Center (SPLC) keessatti hojjechaa turan, yakka malaammaltummaa fi qarshii seeraan alaa qabuuf to'annoo jala oolchaniiru. Mootummaan Trump akka himatutti, namtichi kun qarshii arjooltotaa irraa walitti qabame, garee humnoota ol-aantummaa sanyii babal'isan to'achuuf ooluu qabu ture, garuu iccitidhaan hoogganoota garee kanniiniif kaffaluuf itti fayyadameera jedhu. Beirich fi gosti seeraa ishee gama biraatiin, himannaan kun dhugaa kan hin qabne fi kaayyoo siyaasaa qofa kan qabu jechuun, dhaabbatichi hojii isaa kan sirrii irratti xiyyeeffate waan ta'eef akka miidhamu gochaa jiru jedhu.

title: Media groups sue Trump over paid access to public social media posts
english: Several media advocacy groups have sued President Donald Trump to stop his company from charging high subscription fees for early access to his social media posts. The lawsuit argues that selling exclusive, real-time information violates the First Amendment and limits the public's right to access government announcements equally. Critics claim this system is corrupt because it allows the president to personally profit from information that significantly impacts the global economy.
amharic: በርካታ የሚዲያ ድርጅቶች ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ ለሚያወጡት መረጃ ቀድሞ ለመድረስ ከፍተኛ ክፍያ መጠየቃቸውን በመቃወም ክስ መስርተዋል። ይህ የክፍያ ስርዓት የመረጃ እኩልነትን እንደሚጥስ እና በህገ መንግስቱ የተረጋገጠውን የመረጃ ነፃነት እንደሚፃረር አቤቱታው ይገልፃል። ተቺዎች ይህ ድርጊት ፕሬዝዳንቱ በአገሪቱ ኢኮኖሚ ላይ ተፅዕኖ በሚያሳድሩ መረጃዎች የግል ጥቅም ለማግኘት የሚሞክሩበት ሙሰኛ አካሄድ ነው ሲሉ ይከሳሉ።
oromo: Dhaabbileen miidiyaa gurguddoon tokko tokko, Preezidaant Doonaald tiraampii fi dhaabbanni isaa miidiyaa hawaasummaa isaanii irratti odeeffannoo argachuuf kaffaltii guddaa gaafachuu isaanii mormuun seeraan himatanii jiru. Himannaan kun akka jedhutti, odeeffannoo hatattamaa ta'e maallaqaan gurguruun mirga hawaasni odeeffannoo walqixa argachuuf qabu kan miidhuu fi mirga dubbii bilisaa kan cabsuudha. Gadaa isaaniitti, tarkaanfiin kun preezidaantichi odeeffannoo gabaa addunyaa irratti dhiibbaa geessisu fayyadamuun fayidaa dhuunfaa argachuuf yaaluu isaa kan agarsiisuu fi malaammaltummaa guddaa akka qabu himatameera.

title: Trump administration plans to give ICE officers electric-shock gloves
english: The U.S. Department of Homeland Security intends to spend up to $20 million to provide immigration agents with specialized gloves that deliver electric shocks. Officials claim these devices are intended to help agents de-escalate difficult situations, but rights advocates are concerned about potential misuse against immigrants and protesters. This decision follows ongoing criticism regarding the use of excessive force and aggressive tactics by ICE personnel.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የሀገር ውስጥ ደህንነት መምሪያ ለኢሚግሬሽን ወኪሎች የኤሌክትሪክ ንዝረት የሚሰጡ ልዩ ጓንቶችን ለመግዛት እስከ 20 ሚሊዮን ዶላር ሊያወጣ መሆኑን አስታውቋል። ባለስልጣናት መሳሪያዎቹ አስቸጋሪ ሁኔታዎችን ለመቆጣጠር ይረዳሉ ቢሉም፣ የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋቾች ግን በስደተኞች እና በተቃዋሚዎች ላይ አላግባብ ጥቅም ላይ ይውላሉ የሚል ስጋት አላቸው። ይህ እርምጃ በICE ሰራተኞች ላይ የሚሰነዘረውን የኃይል አጠቃቀም ትችት ተከትሎ የመጣ ነው።
oromo: Manni Maree Nageenya Biyoolessaa Ameerikaa jila godhattoota godaantotaa fi baqattootaa to'atuuf gilaavii elektirikii gadhiisan bituuf hanga miiliyoona 20 doolaaraa baasuuf karoorfateera. Mootummaan meeshaaleen kun rakkoo uumame tasgabbeessuuf gargaaru jedheera; garuu mirga namoomaa falmitoonni godaantota irratti miidhaan akka hin geenye yaaddoo qabu. Murteen kun tarkaanfii jabaa fi humna darbe ICE fudhachaa jiru irratti qeeqni guddaan erga ka'ee booda kan dhufe dha.

title: Why are 'human fridges' being sold in Japan?
english: Japan is experiencing record-breaking summer temperatures that have led to tens of thousands of heatstroke cases and nearly 80 deaths. In response, a new cooling device called the Do Hiemon, or 'Cooling Box,' has been introduced for public and commercial use. Inspired by freezer vending machines, these specialized units are designed to help people escape the extreme heat.
amharic: ጃፓን እጅግ በጣም ከፍተኛ የሆነ የሙቀት መጠን እያጋጠማት ሲሆን ይህም በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎችን ለህመም እና ለሞት ዳርጓል። ለዚህ ችግር መፍትሄ ይሆን ዘንድ 'የማቀዝቀዣ ሳጥን' በመባል የሚታወቀው አዲስ መሳሪያ በህዝብ ቦታዎች እና በንግድ ድርጅቶች ውስጥ አገልግሎት ላይ ውሏል። መሳሪያው ከማቀዝቀዣ ማሽኖች በተገኘ ሀሳብ የተፈጠረ ሲሆን፣ ሰዎች ከከፍተኛ ሙቀት እራሳቸውን እንዲከላከሉ ታስቦ የተዘጋጀ ነው።
oromo: Jaappaan keessatti ho’i baay’ee ol ka’uun isaa namoota kumaatama hedduu irratti miidhaa guddaa geessisee jira. Haala kana dandamachuuf, meeshaan 'Saanduqa qabbaneessaa' jedhamu kan gabaa irratti dhiyaate yoo ta’u, kunis iddoowwan ummataa fi bakka hojiitti itti fayyadamuuf gargaara. Meeshaan kun kan uumame yaadannoo maashiniiwwan qabbaneessoo irraa ka’uun yoo ta’u, kaayyoon isaas namoota ho’a cimaa irraa hambisuu dha.

title: US strikes in Yemen killed 153 civilians in 2025, says Pentagon review
english: A recent Pentagon report reveals that United States military operations in Yemen caused 153 civilian deaths and 243 injuries during 2025. These casualties all occurred across three specific strikes conducted in April, with the attack on the Ras Isa fuel port being the most destructive. While US officials stated the missions were intended to disrupt Houthi funding and resources, the assessment confirmed that these operations resulted in significant unintended loss of life.
amharic: የፔንታጎን አዲስ ዘገባ እንደሚያሳየው እ.ኤ.አ. በ2025 በየመን በተካሄዱ የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ጥቃቶች 153 ንጹሃን ዜጎች ሲሞቱ ሌሎች 243 ሰዎች ደግሞ ቆስለዋል። እነዚህ ጉዳቶች በሙሉ በኤፕሪል ወር በተፈጸሙ ሶስት ጥቃቶች የደረሱ ሲሆን፣ በተለይም በራስ ኢሳ የነዳጅ ማዕከል ላይ የተደረገው ጥቃት ከፍተኛው የሰው ህይወት ተቀጥፏል። አሜሪካ ጥቃቱን የፈጸመችው የሁቲ ታጣቂዎችን የገቢ ምንጭ ለማስተጓጎል እንደሆነ ብትገልጽም፣ ምርመራው ግን ድርጊቱ ያልታሰበ ከፍተኛ የሰው ህይወት መጥፋት እንዳስከተለ አረጋግጧል።
oromo: Gabaasni Pentagooni dhiheenya bahe akka ibsetti, bara 2025 keessa haleellaa waraana Ameerikaan Yemen keessatti gaggeeffameen namoonni nagaa 153 lubbuun darbuu fi 243 ammoo madaa'uu beekameera. Miidhaan kun hundi haleellaa baatii Epreel keessa bakka sadiitti gaggeeffame keessatti kan uumame yoo ta'u, haleellaa buufata boba'aa Raas Isaa irratti raawwatame keessatti miidhaan guddaan geessifameera. Mootummaan Ameerikaa haleellaa kana kan raawwate aanga'oota Houtii kan maallaqa irraa argatan ittisuuf ta'us, qorannoon Pentagooni garuu haleellaan kun namoota nagaa irratti miidhaa guddaa geessisuu isaa mirkaneesseera.

title: Hegseth cautions that ICC may investigate US boat strikes in Latin America
english: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth has warned that the International Criminal Court might investigate American military operations targeting drug boats in Latin America. While the US claims these strikes against cartels are legal, human rights organizations argue they constitute extrajudicial killings that have caused many civilian casualties. In response, Hegseth is urging regional allies to reject the court's authority as part of a broader Trump administration effort to challenge the tribunal.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መከላከያ ሚኒስትር ፒት ሄግሴዝ፣ ዓለም አቀፉ የወንጀለኞች ፍርድ ቤት በላቲን አሜሪካ በሚካሄዱ የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ የባህር ላይ ጥቃቶች ላይ ምርመራ ሊያካሂድ እንደሚችል አስጠንቅቀዋል። አሜሪካ በኮንትሮባንድ ነጋዴዎች ላይ የምትወስዳቸው እርምጃዎች ህጋዊ ናቸው ብትልም፣ የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋቾች ግን ጥቃቶቹ የብዙ ንፁሃን ህይወት የቀጠፉ ህገ-ወጥ ግድያዎች መሆናቸውን ይከራከራሉ። የሄግሴዝ አስተዳደር አጋር ሀገራት የፍርድ ቤቱን ስልጣን እንዲቃወሙ ግፊት እያደረገ ይገኛል።
oromo: Ministirri ittisa biyyaa Ameerikaa Pete Hegseth, Manni Murtii Yakka Addunyaa duula waraana Ameerikaa kan lafa garba Laatiin Ameerikaatti godhamu irratti qorannoo geggeessuu akka malu akeekkachiisaniiru. Ameerikaan tarkaanfii garee sammattu qoricha sammuu irratti fudhattu seera qabeessa ta'uu ibsituus, dhaabbileen mirga namoomaa garuu tarkaanfichi ajjeechaa seeraan alaa ta'uu fi lubbuu namoota nagaa hedduu galaafachuu isaa himu. Hegseth mootummoota naannichaa biraa fi harka caalu irraa kanneen duula kana deggeran, aangoo mana murtichaa akka hin beekneef dhiibbaa gochaa jiru.

title: PSG win back-to-back UEFA Super Cups with victory over Aston Villa
english: Paris Saint-Germain successfully defended their UEFA Super Cup title by defeating Aston Villa 2-1 in Salzburg. Khvicha Kvaratskhelia and Desire Doue scored for the French side, while 17-year-old Brian Madjo netted a historic debut goal for Villa. This victory marks PSG's second consecutive Super Cup win, a feat not achieved by any club since Real Madrid in 2017.
amharic: ፓሪስ ሴንት ጀርሜን አስቶን ቪላን 2 ለ 1 በማሸነፍ የUEFA ሱፐር ካፕ ዋንጫን በድጋሚ ማሳካት ችለዋል። ለፓሪስ ሴንት ጀርሜን ድል መገኘት ክቪቻ ክቫራትስኬሊያ እና ዴዚሬ ዱዌ ግቦቹን ያስቆጠሩ ሲሆን፣ ለቪላ የ17 ዓመቱ ብሪያን ማጆ በታሪክ የመጀመሪያ የውድድር ጨዋታው ግብ ማስቆጠር ችሏል። ይህ ድል ፓሪስ ሴንት ጀርሜን ከ2017 ወዲህ በውድድሩ ተከታታይ ሁለት ዋንጫዎችን ያነሳ የመጀመሪያው ክለብ እንዲሆን አስችሎታል።
oromo: Pariis Saint-Jarmeen Aston Viilaa 2-1 injifachuun waancaa UEFA Super Cup yeroo lammaffaaf walitti aansee fudhateera. Pariis Saint-Jarmeeniif Kviichaa Kvaaratskeliyaa fi Deziiree Duwee goolii lakkoofsiseera, yeroo Viilaaf dargaggeessi waggaa 17 Brian Maajo tapha isaa jalqabaa irratti goolii seena qabeessa galcheera. Injifannoon kun Pariis Saint-Jarmeen akka Real Maadrid bara 2017 booda waancaa kana walitti aansee fudhate tokkoffaa akka ta'u isa taasiseera.

title: Thousands missing after Colombia quake as rescue continues
english: A massive 7.4-magnitude earthquake recently struck western Colombia, resulting in hundreds of deaths and leaving thousands of people unaccounted for. Rescue crews are currently working through the debris of destroyed buildings to find survivors. However, relief operations are facing significant challenges due to broken communication lines and a shortage of medical resources in hospitals.
amharic: በምዕራብ ኮሎምቢያ የተከሰተው የ7.4 ማግኒትዩድ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎችን ህይወት የቀጠፈ ሲሆን በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች ደግሞ የት እንደደረሱ አልታወቀም። የአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች በፈራረሱ ህንጻዎች ስር የተረፉ ሰዎችን ለመፈለግ ከፍተኛ ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው። ይሁን እንጂ የቴሌኮሙኒኬሽን መቋረጥ እና የህክምና ቁሳቁስ እጥረት የነፍስ አድን ስራውን አስቸጋሪ አድርጎታል።
oromo: Biyya Kolombiyaa kutaa dhihaa keessatti sochii lafaa cimaa hamma 7.4 ta'een namoonni dhibbaan lakkaa'aman lubbuun darbanii, kumni dhibbaan lakkaa'amammmoo eessa akka jiran hin beekamu. Ogeessonni fayyadamtootaa fi gargaartonni namoota caccabaa manaa jala jiran barbaaduuf carraaqqii cimaa gochaa jiru. Ta'us, rakkoon quunnamtii fi hanqinni qoricha fi meeshaalee fayyaa hojii gargaarsaa sana ulfaataa godheera.

title: Morocco says working to prevent potential new Ceuta crossings surge
english: Moroccan authorities have strengthened security along the borders of the Spanish exclaves Ceuta and Melilla to prevent unauthorized migration. This move follows the spread of social media rumors falsely claiming the border would be opened for mass crossings on August 15. The government is also taking legal action against those who incite illegal entry or spread disinformation online.
amharic: የሞሮኮ ባለስልጣናት ወደ ስፔን ግዛት Ceuta እና Melilla ድንበሮች የሚደረጉ ህገ-ወጥ የሰዎች ፍልሰቶችን ለመከላከል የጸጥታ ጥበቃን አጠናክረዋል። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው በነሐሴ 15 ቀን ድንበሩ ለጅምላ መሻገሪያ ክፍት እንደሚሆን በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ የተሰራጨውን የሀሰት ወሬ ተከትሎ ነው። መንግስት ህገ-ወጥ መሻገሪያዎችን የሚያበረታቱ ወይም የሀሰት መረጃዎችን የሚያሰራጩ አካላት ላይ ህጋዊ እርምጃ እየወሰደ ይገኛል።
oromo: Mootummaan Marookoo daangaa biyyattii gara magaalaalee Ispeen kan ta'an Ceuta fi Melilla irra jiru eegumsa isaa cimseera. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame erga miidiyaa hawaasaarratti oollee kanaan dura guyyaa Hagayya 15 daangaan ni banama jedhee sobaan babal'ate boodadha. Mootummaan namoota yaalii godaansaa seeraan alaa kakaasan ykn odeeffannoo sobaa babal'isanirratti tarkaanfii seeraa fudhachaa jira.

title: 11-year-old boy shot by Israeli forces in Gaza
english: An 11-year-old boy in Khan Younis, Gaza, has been shot in the head and leg by Israeli military forces, according to his father. This incident is part of a broader surge in violence that has resulted in over 1,200 Palestinian deaths and thousands of injuries since last October. The ongoing conflict continues to cause severe casualties and humanitarian distress across the region.
amharic: በጋዛ ካን ዩኒስ የሚኖር የ11 ዓመት ህጻን በእስራኤል ወታደሮች ጭንቅላቱ እና እግሩ ላይ በጥይት መመታቱን የአካባቢው ምንጮች እና የህጻኑ አባት አስታውቀዋል። ይህ አሳዛኝ ድርጊት ካለፈው ጥቅምት ወር ጀምሮ በእስራኤል እና ፍልስጤም መካከል በተቀሰቀሰው ግጭት ከ1,200 በላይ ፍልስጤማውያን ከተገደሉባቸው እና በሺዎች ከሚቆጠሩት ጥቃቶች አንዱ ነው። ቀጣይነት ያለው ግጭት በክልሉ ከፍተኛ የሰው ህይወት መጥፋት እና ሰብአዊ ቀውስ እያስከተለ ይገኛል።
oromo: Gaza, magaalaa Khan Younis keessatti ijoolleen waggaa 11 tokko rasaasa waraana Israa'eliin mataa fi miilla irraa miidhamuu isaa abbaan isaa ibseera. Miidhaan kun kan hordofe waraana ji'a Onkoloolessa darbe irraa kaasee itti fufeen lubbuun namoota Falasxiin 1,200 ol darbee fi kumaan kan lakkaa'aman ammoo madaa'anii jiru. Walitti bu'iinsi kun naannichatti lubbuu namoota baay'ee galaafachuu fi miidhaa guddaa geessisuu isaa itti fufeera.

title: Drone attacks on energy infrastructure deepen Libya’s energy crisis
english: Libya is facing a severe energy crisis due to recurring drone strikes targeting its oil and power facilities. These attacks have disrupted fuel distribution and increased the frequency of blackouts across the country. The situation is further aggravated by ongoing conflicts between rival factions vying for control over the city of Az Zawiya.
amharic: ሊቢያ በነዳጅ እና በኤሌክትሪክ መሰረተ ልማቶቿ ላይ በሚሰነዘሩ ተደጋጋሚ የድሮን ጥቃቶች የከፋ የሃይል ቀውስ ውስጥ ትገኛለች። እነዚህ ጥቃቶች የነዳጅ አቅርቦትን በማስተጓጎል በሀገሪቱ የኤሌክትሪክ መቆራረጥ እንዲባባስ አድርገዋል። የአዝዛዊያን ከተማን ለመቆጣጠር በሚፎካከሩ ቡድኖች መካከል ያለው ግጭትም ችግሩን ይበልጥ አወሳስቦታል።
oromo: Liibiya bu'uuraalee misoomaa kanneen akka boba'aa fi elektirikii irratti miidhaa ga'aa jiruun rakkoo humna elektirikii hamaa keessa seentee jirti. Haleellaan xiyyaara maleeyyuun kun dhiyeessii boba'aa waan gufuu ta'eef, guutummaa biyyattiitti hir'inni ibsaa dabaluu isaati. Wal dorgommii gareelee magaalaa Az Zawiya to'achuuf wal irratti godhanis rakkoo kana caalaatti hammaachiisee jira.

title: Israeli air strike kills one in northern Gaza
english: An Israeli airstrike in northern Gaza killed a municipal worker and injured five others while they were traveling in a vehicle after performing maintenance work. The Israeli military stated the attack aimed to neutralize a Hamas commander, marking a return to aerial bombardment after a brief period of reduced activity. These incidents occurred amidst ongoing regional tension and the rejection of a recent U.S.-led peace proposal.
amharic: በሰሜናዊ ጋዛ በእስራኤል በተፈጸመ የአየር ጥቃት አንድ የከተማ አስተዳደር ሰራተኛ ሲገደል አምስት ሰዎች ደግሞ ቆስለዋል። ጥቃቱ የተፈጸመው ሰራተኞቹ የውሃ ጉድጓድ ጥገና አድርገው በመመለስ ላይ እያሉ ሲሆን፣ እስራኤልም ኢላማው የሃማስ አዛዥ እንደነበር አስታውቃለች። ይህ ጥቃት የአሜሪካ የሰላም እቅድ ውድቅ ከተደረገ በኋላ እና ለተወሰነ ጊዜ ቀንሶ የነበረው የአየር ላይ ጥቃት እንደገና በመቀጠሉ በአካባቢው ያለውን ውጥረት አባብሶታል።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el gama kaaba Gaazaatti qilleensa irraa haleellaa gaggeesseen hojjetaan tajaajila magaalummaa tokko yommuu du'u, shanan immoo madaa'aniiru. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame hojjettoonni kun hojii suphaa boolla bishaanii booda osoo deebi'aa jiranii ta'uun ibsameera; Israa'el gama isheetiin haleellaan kun ajaja humna Hamaas irratti kan xiyyeeffate ture jetteetti. Haleellaan kun kan dhufe erga karoorri nagaa Ameerikaan dhiyeessite didamee fi haleellaan qilleensa irraa yeroo gabaabaaf dhaabbatee ture erga deebi'ee booda.

title: Lebanon passes sweeping amnesty law for prisoners, wanted people
english: The Lebanese parliament has approved a major amnesty law for the first time since 1991 to help address severe prison overcrowding and long trial delays. This new legislation will reduce sentences and pardon thousands of individuals, including those who have been waiting in jail for years. The decision follows years of political debate and gained new momentum following the recent political changes in neighboring Syria.
amharic: የሊባኖስ ፓርላማ ከ1991 ወዲህ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ በወህኒ ቤቶች ውስጥ ያለውን መጨናነቅ ለመቀነስ እና ረጅም የፍርድ ሂደት በመጠበቅ ላይ ያሉ እስረኞችን ለመርዳት የሚያስችል አጠቃላይ የምህረት አዋጅ አጽድቋል። ይህ አዲስ ህግ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ እስረኞችን የሚጠቅም ሲሆን፣ የቅጣት ጊዜያቸውን የሚቀንስ ወይም ነጻ የሚያስለቅቅ ነው። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው ለዓመታት ሲነሱ የነበሩ የፖለቲካ ጥያቄዎችን ለመመለስ እና በሶሪያ ውስጥ የተከሰተውን የፖለቲካ ለውጥ ተከትሎ ነው።
oromo: Mana mareen biyya Libaanon erga bara 1991 asitti yeroo jalqabaaf labsiin dhiifama waliigalaa mana hidhaa keessatti walitti dhufeenya uumame hir’isuuf gargaaru raggaasiseera. Labsiin kun hidhamtoota bara dheeraaf murtiishee eeggataa turaniifi namoota barbaadamaa turan kumaatamaatti fayyadama. Murteen kun waggoota dheeraaf falmii siyaasaa erga turee booda, jijjiirama siyaasaa biyya Suuriyaa keessatti dhiheenya kana mudate hordofuun kan ragga’e dha.

title: Israel vows to keep troops in Lebanon, Gaza and Syria
english: Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz has declared that the nation will maintain its military presence in Gaza, Lebanon, and Syria. He emphasized that there are no plans to withdraw troops from these security zones under any circumstances. This announcement follows a previously proposed agreement that was intended to pull Israeli forces out of the southern region of Lebanon.
amharic: የእስራኤል መከላከያ ሚኒስትር እስራኤል ካትዝ ሀገራቸው በጋዛ፣ በሊባኖስ እና በሶሪያ ያሰማራችውን ወታደራዊ ኃይል እንደማታስወጣ አስታውቀዋል። በማንኛውም ሁኔታ ከእነዚህ የጸጥታ ቀጠናዎች ወታደሮቻቸውን ለማስወጣት ምንም አይነት እቅድ እንደሌላቸውም አሳስበዋል። ይህ መግለጫ ቀደም ሲል ከደቡብ ሊባኖስ ወታደሮችን ለማስወጣት የተደረገውን ስምምነት ተከትሎ የመጣ ነው።
oromo: Ministirri Raayyaa Ittisa Israa'el Israa'el Kaatz, biyyattii waraana ishee Gaaza, Libaanoos fi Sooriyaa keessa jiru akka hin baafne ibsaniiru. Haala kamiinuu bakkeewwan nageenyaa kana keessaa waraana ishee baasuuf karoora akka hin qabne mirkaneessaniiru. Labsiin kunis kanaan dura waraana Israa'el kibba Libaanoos keessaa baasuuf waliigaltee irra ga'amee ture booda kan dhufe dha.

title: Photos: Solar eclipse plunges parts of Europe into darkness
english: Millions of people across Europe and other regions recently witnessed a total solar eclipse for the first time in 27 years. The moon completely blocked the sun, creating several minutes of darkness for those living along the path of totality, which included Iceland, Russia, Greenland, Spain, and Portugal. Additionally, many other areas across the globe were able to observe a partial eclipse during the event.
amharic: ሚሊዮኖች የሚቆጠሩ የአውሮፓ እና ሌሎች አካባቢዎች ነዋሪዎች ከ27 ዓመታት በኋላ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ ሙሉ የፀሐይ ግርዶሽን ተመልክተዋል። ጨረቃ ሙሉ በሙሉ ፀሐይን በመሸፈኗ በአይስላንድ፣ በሩሲያ፣ በግሪንላንድ፣ በስፔን እና በፖርቱጋል መስመር ላይ የነበሩ ሰዎች ለተወሰኑ ደቂቃዎች በድንገተኛ ጨለማ ውስጥ እንዲያሳልፉ አድርጋለች። ከዚህ በተጨማሪም በዓለም ዙሪያ የሚገኙ ሌሎች በርካታ አካባቢዎች የፀሐይ ግርዶሹን በከፊል ማየት ችለዋል።
oromo: Miliyoonaan lakkaa'aman uummata Awurooppaa fi naannoowwan biroo keessa jiraatan waggaa 27 booda yeroo jalqatiif ifa aduu guutummaatti haguugame arganiiru. Jiini aduu guutummaatti haguuguun isaa, naannoowwan akka Aayislaandi, Raashiyaa, Giriinlaandi, Ispeenii fi Poorchugaal keessa turan daqiiqoota muraasaaf dukkana keessa akka turan taasiseera. Kana malees, addunyaa irratti bakkeewwan biroo hedduun ifa aduu kana hir’atee ykn hir’inaan arguu danda’aniiru.

title: ‘Platformicide’ of Palestine: Activists struggle to be heard on Meta
english: A new report highlights a trend of digital suppression where pro-Palestinian activists are facing account suspensions and reduced visibility on Meta platforms like Instagram. Journalists and activists report that their content is being shadow-banned, making it difficult for their accounts to reach their followers during the ongoing conflict. Despite raising these concerns directly with Meta, users claim the company has failed to address these issues or provide a clear explanation for the widespread silencing.

title: Trump reveals Karoline Leavitt to step down as White House press secretary
english: White House Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt is stepping down from her position at the end of the month to focus on her family following the birth of her second child. President Donald Trump praised her past performance and confirmed she will transition into an advisory role for his administration and the Republican Party. Her departure is part of a broader trend of leadership changes occurring within the current Trump administration.
